        + Octonion.conj

    hφ.nakayamaAut = AlgEquiv.refl ↔ ∀ a b : A, φ (a * b) = φ (b * a)

name: LinearMap.IsFrobeniusFunctional.of_left
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.IsFrobeniusFunctional.of_left
    (h : ∀ a : A, (∀ b, φ (a * b) = 0) → a = 0) : φ.IsFrobeniusFunctional

name: LinearMap.IsFrobeniusFunctional.of_right
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.IsFrobeniusFunctional.of_right
    (h : ∀ b : A, (∀ a, φ (a * b) = 0) → b = 0) : φ.IsFrobeniusFunctional

name: LinearMap.IsFrobeniusFunctional.op
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.IsFrobeniusFunctional.op (hφ : φ.IsFrobeniusFunctional) :
    (φ ∘ₗ (MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv k (M := A)).symm.toLinearMap).IsFrobeniusFunctional

name: LinearMap.IsSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional.nakayamaAut_eq_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.LinearMap.IsSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional.nakayamaAut_eq_refl
    (hφ : φ.IsSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional) :
    hφ.isFrobeniusFunctional.nakayamaAut = AlgEquiv.refl

name: LinearMap.exists_isFrobeniusFunctional_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.exists_isFrobeniusFunctional_iff :
    (∃ φ : A →ₗ[k] k, φ.IsFrobeniusFunctional) ↔
      ∃ e : A ≃ₗ[k] Module.Dual k A, ∀ a c : A, e (a * c) = DomMulAct.mk c • e a

name: LinearMap.isFrobeniusFunctional_apply_one
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.isFrobeniusFunctional_apply_one {e : A ≃ₗ[k] Module.Dual k A}
    (he : ∀ a c : A, e (a * c) = DomMulAct.mk c • e a) : (e 1).IsFrobeniusFunctional

name: LinearMap.isFrobeniusFunctional_iff
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.isFrobeniusFunctional_iff :
    φ.IsFrobeniusFunctional ↔
      (∀ a : A, (∀ b, φ (a * b) = 0) → a = 0) ∧ ∀ b : A, (∀ a, φ (a * b) = 0) → b = 0

name: LinearMap.isFrobeniusFunctional_iff_bijective
statement:
theorem _root_.LinearMap.isFrobeniusFunctional_iff_bijective :
    φ.IsFrobeniusFunctional ↔ Bijective ((LinearMap.mul k A).compr₂ φ)

name: AdjoinRoot.isSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional_lastCoeff
statement:
theorem _root_.AdjoinRoot.isSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional_lastCoeff (hg : g.Monic) :
    (AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff hg).IsSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional

name: AdjoinRoot.isSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional_lastCoeff_X_pow
statement:
theorem _root_.AdjoinRoot.isSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional_lastCoeff_X_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff (monic_X_pow n : (X ^ n : R[X]).Monic)).IsSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional

name: AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff_X_pow_root_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff_X_pow_root_pow (n i : ℕ) :
    AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff (monic_X_pow n) (AdjoinRoot.root (X ^ n : R[X]) ^ i) =
      if i + 1 = n then 1 else 0

name: AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff_eq_repr
statement:
theorem _root_.AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff_eq_repr (hg : g.Monic) (hd : 0 < g.natDegree)
    (a : AdjoinRoot g) :
    AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff hg a =
      (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hg).basis.repr a ⟨g.natDegree - 1, Nat.sub_one_lt_of_lt hd⟩

name: AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff_root_pow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff_root_pow (hg : g.Monic) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < g.natDegree) :
    AdjoinRoot.lastCoeff hg (AdjoinRoot.root g ^ i) = if i + 1 = g.natDegree then 1 else 0

name: Matrix.isSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional_traceLinearMap
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.isSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional_traceLinearMap (n : Type*) [Fintype n]
    [DecidableEq n] : (Matrix.traceLinearMap n k k).IsSymmetricFrobeniusFunctional

name: AlgHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra_apply
statement:
-- Proved from `RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra` and `AlgHom.coe_toRingHom` rather than by `rfl`:
-- both sides are definitionally equal, but `rfl` closes the goal only by reducing through
-- `toRingHom`, `toAlgebra`, `algebraMap` and two coercions -- exactly the fragile defeq this
-- lemma exists to spare its call sites.
theorem AlgHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra_apply {R A B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring A]
    [CommSemiring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (z : A) :
    @algebraMap A B _ _ f.toRingHom.toAlgebra z = f z

name: AlgHom.toRingHom_toIntAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AlgHom.toRingHom_toIntAlgHom (φ : R →ₐ[ℤ] S) : ((φ : R →+* S)).toIntAlgHom = φ

name: RingHom.toIntAlgHom_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem RingHom.toIntAlgHom_comp (f : S →+* T) (g : R →+* S) :
    (f.comp g).toIntAlgHom = f.toIntAlgHom.comp g.toIntAlgHom

name: RingHom.toIntAlgHom_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem RingHom.toIntAlgHom_id : (RingHom.id R).toIntAlgHom = AlgHom.id ℤ R

name: RingHom.toIntAlgHom_toRingHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem RingHom.toIntAlgHom_toRingHom (f : R →+* S) : (f.toIntAlgHom : R →+* S) = f

name: Pi.evalAlgHomEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evalAlgHomEquiv_apply (s : ι) :
    evalAlgHomEquiv R ι s = Pi.evalAlgHom R (fun _ => R) s

name: Pi.evalAlgHom_injective
statement:
theorem evalAlgHom_injective [Nontrivial R] :
    Function.Injective (Pi.evalAlgHom R fun _ : ι => R)

name: AlgHom.map_eq_map_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_eq_map_fst (φ : (A × C) →ₐ[F] B) (hu : φ (1, 0) = 1) (p : A × C) :
    φ p = φ (p.1, 0)

name: AlgHom.map_zero_one_eq_zero
statement:
-- Deliberately not `@[simp]`: with `map_eq_map_fst` below tagged, `simpNF` rejects this one as
-- redundant, since that lemma already rewrites `φ (0, 1)` to `φ (0, 0)` for `map_zero` to finish.
theorem map_zero_one_eq_zero (φ : (A × C) →ₐ[F] B) (hu : φ (1, 0) = 1) : φ (0, 1) = 0

name: AlgHom.prodFirst_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodFirst_apply (φ : (A × C) →ₐ[F] B) (hu : φ (1, 0) = 1) (a : A) :
    prodFirst φ hu a = φ (a, 0)

name: AlgHom.prodFirst_comp_fst
statement:
@[simp]
theorem prodFirst_comp_fst (φ : (A × C) →ₐ[F] B) (hu : φ (1, 0) = 1) :
    (prodFirst φ hu).comp (AlgHom.fst F A C) = φ

name: AlgHom.prodFirst_surjective
statement:
theorem prodFirst_surjective (φ : (A × C) →ₐ[F] B) (hu : φ (1, 0) = 1)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective φ) : Function.Surjective (prodFirst φ hu)

name: Algebra.algebraMap_botEquivOfInjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem algebraMap_botEquivOfInjective (h : Function.Injective (algebraMap R A))
    (x : (⊥ : Subalgebra R A)) : algebraMap R A (botEquivOfInjective h x) = (x : A)

name: TauCeti.centralizer_eq_self_of_forall_finrank_le
statement:
theorem centralizer_eq_self_of_forall_finrank_le {L : Subalgebra K A} [IsMulCommutative ↥L]
    (hmax : ∀ M : Subalgebra K A, IsMulCommutative ↥M → finrank K ↥M ≤ finrank K ↥L) :
    Subalgebra.centralizer K (L : Set A) = L

name: TauCeti.exists_isMulCommutative_forall_finrank_le
statement:
theorem exists_isMulCommutative_forall_finrank_le :
    ∃ L : Subalgebra K A, IsMulCommutative ↥L ∧
      ∀ M : Subalgebra K A, IsMulCommutative ↥M → finrank K ↥M ≤ finrank K ↥L

name: AlgHom.restrictScalars_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem AlgHom.restrictScalars_comp (f : B →ₐ[S] C) (g : A →ₐ[S] B) :
    (f.comp g).restrictScalars R = (f.restrictScalars R).comp (g.restrictScalars R)

name: BialgHomClass.coe_comp_antipode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.BialgHomClass.coe_comp_antipode (φ : F) :
    (φ : A →ₗ[R] B).comp (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := A)) =
      (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (A := B)).comp (φ : A →ₗ[R] B)

name: BialgHomClass.map_antipode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem _root_.BialgHomClass.map_antipode (φ : F) (a : A) :
    φ (HopfAlgebra.antipode R a) = HopfAlgebra.antipode R (φ a)

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.convInv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma convInv_apply (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H) :
    f⁻¹ h = f.ofConv (antipode R h)

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapValue_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapValue φ f = toConv (φ.comp f.ofConv)

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_comp
statement:
lemma mapValue_comp (ψ : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    mapValue (H := H) (ψ.comp φ) = (mapValue ψ).comp (mapValue φ)

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapValue_id :
    mapValue (H := H) (AlgHom.id R A) = MonoidHom.id (WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A))

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_injective
statement:
lemma mapValue_injective {φ : A →ₐ[R] B} (hφ : Function.Injective φ) :
    Function.Injective (mapValue (H := H) φ)

name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.antipodeHom_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antipodeHom_ι (x : M) :
    antipodeHom R M (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) =
      -(_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.antipode_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antipode_ι (x : M) :
    antipode R (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) = -(_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.convMul_apply_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem convMul_apply_ι (F G : WithConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) (x : M) :
    (F * G).ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) =
      F.ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x) +
        G.ofConv (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

name: TauCeti.SymmetricAlgebra.lift_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lift_symm_apply (H : _root_.SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A) (x : M) :
    _root_.SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm H x = H (_root_.SymmetricAlgebra.ι R M x)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointParamMul_apply_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaPointParamMul_apply_ι (F G : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (gaPointParamMul F G).ofConv (ι R R 1) =
      F.ofConv (ι R R 1) * G.ofConv (ι R R 1)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_gaPointParamMul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_gaPointParamMul
    (F G : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    gaPointsMulEquiv (gaPointParamMul F G) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F) *
          Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv G))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    gaPointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹) = (gaPointsMulEquiv F)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ F) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ (Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F)))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι (a : Multiplicative A) :
    ((gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm a).ofConv (ι R R 1) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd a

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_gaPointParamMul
statement:
theorem mapValue_gaPointParamMul (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F G : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ (gaPointParamMul F G) =
      gaPointParamMul
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ F)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ G)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem mapValue_gaPointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (a : Multiplicative A) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ
        ((gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm a) =
      (gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)).symm
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ (Multiplicative.toAdd a)))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (ψ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)).symm ψ) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)).symm
        (Multiplicative.ofAdd (φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd ψ)))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹) = (pointsMulEquiv F)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ F) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd
        (φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F)))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := A)).symm φ =
      toConv (SymmetricAlgebra.lift (Multiplicative.toAdd φ))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F) = F.ofConv (ι R R 1)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_inv
statement:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹)) = -Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        (gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
          (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) φ F)) =
      φ (Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F) = SymmetricAlgebra.lift.symm F.ofConv

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_apply (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) (x : M) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F) x = F.ofConv (ι R M x)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_inv
statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_inv (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv (F⁻¹)) = -Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem toAdd_pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd
        (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (M := M) (A := B)
          (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R M) φ F)) =
      φ.toLinearMap.comp (Multiplicative.toAdd (pointsMulEquiv F))

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapDomainMulEquiv_apply (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapDomainMulEquiv e f = mapDomain (e : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) f

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomainMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapDomainMulEquiv_symm_apply (e : H₁ ≃ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (mapDomainMulEquiv (A := A) e).symm f = mapDomain (e.symm : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₁) f

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapDomain_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    mapDomain φ f = toConv (f.ofConv.comp (φ : H₁ →ₐ[R] H₂))

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_apply_apply
statement:
lemma mapDomain_apply_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H₁) :
    mapDomain φ f h = f.ofConv (φ h)

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_comp
statement:
lemma mapDomain_comp (ψ : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₃) (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) :
    (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₃) (ψ.comp φ) :
        WithConv (H₃ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) =
      (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
          WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)).comp
        (mapDomain (H₁ := H₂) (H₂ := H₃) ψ :
          WithConv (H₃ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A))

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_id
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapDomain_id :
    (mapDomain (BialgHom.id R H₁) : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) =
      MonoidHom.id (WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A))

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapDomain_inv_apply
statement:
lemma mapDomain_inv_apply (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (f : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H₁) :
    mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ (f⁻¹ : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) h =
      f.ofConv (HopfAlgebra.antipode R (φ h))

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_algebraOfId
statement:
lemma mapValue_algebraOfId (x : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A))
    (g : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] R)) :
    mapValue (H := H₁) x.ofConv
        (mapValue (H := H₁) (Algebra.ofId R H₁) g) =
      mapValue (H := H₁) (Algebra.ofId R A) g

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.mapValue_mapDomain
statement:
lemma mapValue_mapDomain (φ : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₂) (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
        WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] B) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] B)).comp
        (mapValue (H := H₂) χ) =
      (mapValue (H := H₁) χ).comp
        (mapDomain (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) φ :
          WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A) →* WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.comul_ι_pow
statement:
theorem comul_ι_pow :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) ((ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p) =
      ((ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p) ⊗ₜ[R] 1 +
        1 ⊗ₜ[R] ((ι R R 1 : SymmetricAlgebra R R) ^ p)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusBialgHom_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem frobeniusBialgHom_ι (r : R) :
    frobeniusBialgHom R p (ι R R r) = r • (ι R R 1) ^ p

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.frobeniusBialgHom_ι_one
statement:
theorem frobeniusBialgHom_ι_one :
    frobeniusBialgHom R p (ι R R 1) = (ι R R 1) ^ p

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.mapValue_frobeniusEnd
statement:
theorem mapValue_frobeniusEnd (χ : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    (frobeniusEnd R p (A := B)).comp (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) χ) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := SymmetricAlgebra R R) χ).comp (frobeniusEnd R p (A := A))

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_frobeniusEnd
statement:
theorem toAdd_gaPointsMulEquiv_frobeniusEnd (F : WithConv (SymmetricAlgebra R R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv (frobeniusEnd R p F)) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd (gaPointsMulEquiv F) ^ p

name: BialgHom.id_toRingHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_toRingHom : (BialgHom.id R A : A →+* A) = RingHom.id A

name: Bialgebra.Quotient.liftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : J ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) :
    (liftBialgHom J f hf).comp (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom J) = f

name: Bialgebra.Quotient.liftBialgHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem liftBialgHom_mk (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : J ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (h : H) :
    liftBialgHom J f hf (Ideal.Quotient.mk J h) = f h

name: Bialgebra.Quotient.liftBialgHom_unique
statement:
theorem liftBialgHom_unique (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : J ≤ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom.toRingHom) (g : H ⧸ J →ₐc[R] K)
    (hg : g.comp (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom J) = f) :
    g = liftBialgHom J f hf

name: Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mkBialgHom_toAlgHom :
    (mkBialgHom (R := R) J).toAlgHom = Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.antipode_mem
statement:
theorem antipode_mem (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    HopfAlgebra.antipode R x ∈ I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.bot_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot_toIdeal : (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal = (⊥ : Ideal H)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comul_mem
statement:
theorem comul_mem (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) x ∈
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal ⊔
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.counit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem counit_eq_zero (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := R) x = 0

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (h : ∀ x : H, x ∈ I ↔ x ∈ J) : I = J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.iSup_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSup_toIdeal {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → HopfIdeal R H) :
    (⨆ i, I i).toIdeal = ⨆ i, (I i).toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.includeLeft_mem_leftTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem includeLeft_mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H) x ∈
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.includeRight_mem_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem includeRight_mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H) x ∈
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_tensorProduct_map_eq_leftTensorIdeal_sup_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem ker_tensorProduct_map_eq_leftTensorIdeal_sup_rightTensorIdeal [Algebra R H]
    {A B : Type*} [Ring A] [Ring B] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    (f : H →ₐ[R] A) (g : H →ₐ[R] B)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hg : Function.Surjective g) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.map f g) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (RingHom.ker f) ⊔
        rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (RingHom.ker g)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_tensorProduct_map_id_quotient
statement:
theorem ker_tensorProduct_map_id_quotient (I : Ideal H) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R H) (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I)) =
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_tensorProduct_map_quotient_id
statement:
theorem ker_tensorProduct_map_quotient_id (I : Ideal H) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I) (AlgHom.id R H)) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.le_def
statement: theorem le_def {I J : HopfIdeal R H} : I ≤ J ↔ ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I → x ∈ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_def
statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_def (I : Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I =
      Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftTensorIdeal_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ i, I i) =
      ⨆ i, leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I i)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_le_iff
statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_le_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ Ideal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem leftTensorIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.leftTensorIdeal_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftTensorIdeal_sup (I J : Ideal H) :
    leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I ⊔ J) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bot {x : H} : x ∈ (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H) ↔ x = 0

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_carrier {I : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} : x ∈ I.carrier ↔ x ∈ I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_iSup
statement:
theorem mem_iSup {ι : Type*} {I : ι → HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} :
    x ∈ ⨆ i, I i ↔ ∃ f : ι →₀ H, (∀ i, f i ∈ I i) ∧ f.sum (fun _ y => y) = x

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_leftTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H ⊗[R] H} :
    x ∈ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      x ∈ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom
        I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_ofIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ofIdeal {I : Ideal H} [I.IsTwoSided] {hcomul hcounit hantipode} {x : H} :
    x ∈ ofIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I hcomul hcounit hantipode ↔ x ∈ I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H ⊗[R] H} :
    x ∈ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ↔
      x ∈ Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_sSup
statement:
theorem mem_sSup {S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)} {x : H} :
    x ∈ sSup S ↔
      ∃ f : S →₀ H, (∀ I : S, f I ∈ (I : HopfIdeal R H)) ∧ f.sum (fun _ y => y) = x

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_sup
statement:
theorem mem_sup {I J : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} :
    x ∈ I ⊔ J ↔ ∃ y ∈ I, ∃ z ∈ J, y + z = x

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_toIdeal {I : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} : x ∈ I.toIdeal ↔ x ∈ I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mul_mem_right
statement:
theorem mul_mem_right (I : HopfIdeal R H) {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) (y : H) :
    x * y ∈ I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ofIdeal_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofIdeal_carrier (I : Ideal H) [I.IsTwoSided] (hcomul hcounit hantipode) :
    (ofIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I hcomul hcounit hantipode).carrier = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ofSpan_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofSpan_toIdeal (S : Set H) [hS : (Ideal.span S).IsTwoSided]
    (hcomul hcounit hantipode) :
    (ofSpan (R := R) (H := H) S hcomul hcounit hantipode).toIdeal = Ideal.span S

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_def
statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_def (I : Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I =
      Ideal.map
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightTensorIdeal_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (⨆ i, I i) =
      ⨆ i, rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I i)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_le_iff
statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_le_iff {I : Ideal H} {J : Ideal (H ⊗[R] H)} :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ J ↔
      I ≤ Ideal.comap
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := H) (B := H)).toRingHom J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_mono
statement:
theorem rightTensorIdeal_mono {I J : Ideal H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ≤ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.rightTensorIdeal_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightTensorIdeal_sup (I J : Ideal H) :
    rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) (I ⊔ J) =
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I ⊔ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.sSup_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sSup_toIdeal (S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)) :
    (sSup S).toIdeal = ⨆ I : S, (I : HopfIdeal R H).toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.sup_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_toIdeal (I J : HopfIdeal R H) : (I ⊔ J).toIdeal = I.toIdeal ⊔ J.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.tmul_mem_leftTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_leftTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) (y : H) :
    x ⊗ₜ[R] y ∈ leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.tmul_mem_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem tmul_mem_rightTensorIdeal {I : Ideal H} (x : H) {y : H} (hy : y ∈ I) :
    x ⊗ₜ[R] y ∈ rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.toIdeal_carrier
statement: theorem toIdeal_carrier (I : HopfIdeal R H) : I.toIdeal = I.carrier

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.toIdeal_le_toIdeal
statement:
theorem toIdeal_le_toIdeal {I J : HopfIdeal R H} :
    I.toIdeal ≤ J.toIdeal ↔ I ≤ J

name: Algebra.TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat
statement:
theorem map_injective_of_flat_flat (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : C →ₐ[R] D)
    [Module.Flat R B] [Module.Flat R C]
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hg : Function.Injective g) :
    Function.Injective (map f g)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.isReduced_quotient_kerOfSurjective
statement:
theorem isReduced_quotient_kerOfSurjective [IsReduced K] (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : IsReduced (H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgEquiv_apply (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (q : H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal) :
    kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf q = kerLiftBialgHom f hf q

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgEquiv_toBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgEquiv_toBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (kerLiftBialgEquiv f hf : H ⧸ (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal →ₐc[R] K) =
      kerLiftBialgHom f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgHom_bijective
statement:
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_bijective (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    Function.Bijective (kerLiftBialgHom f hf)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_comp_mkBialgHom (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (kerLiftBialgHom f hf).comp
        (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal) = f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerLiftBialgHom_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerLiftBialgHom_mk (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) (h : H) :
    kerLiftBialgHom f hf (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal h) = f h

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerOfSurjective_eq_bot_iff (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    kerOfSurjective f hf = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective_eq_ker
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerOfSurjective_eq_ker (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    [Module.Flat R (H ⧸ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom)] (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    kerOfSurjective f hf = ker f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective_mkBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerOfSurjective_mkBialgHom (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    kerOfSurjective (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal)
      Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.kerOfSurjective_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem kerOfSurjective_toIdeal (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (kerOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal = RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_eq_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_eq_bot_iff (f : H →ₐc[R] K) [Module.Flat R (H ⧸ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom)] :
    ker f = ⊥ ↔ Function.Injective f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_lTensor_eq_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
theorem ker_lTensor_eq_rightTensorIdeal {A B : Type*} [Ring A] [Ring B]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Module.Flat R A] (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    RingHom.ker (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R A) f) =
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := A) (RingHom.ker f)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_le_ker_comp
statement:
theorem ker_le_ker_comp {L : Type x} [Ring L] [HopfAlgebra R L]
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (g : K →ₐc[R] L)
    [Module.Flat R L] [Module.Flat R (H ⧸ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom)]
    [Module.Flat R (H ⧸ RingHom.ker (g.comp f).toAlgHom)] : ker f ≤ ker (g.comp f)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_mkBialgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_mkBialgHom (I : HopfIdeal R H)
    [Module.Flat R (H ⧸ I.toIdeal)] :
    haveI : Module.Flat R
        (H ⧸ RingHom.ker (Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom (R := R) I.toIdeal).toAlgHom)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ker_toIdeal (f : H →ₐc[R] K) [Module.Flat R (H ⧸ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom)] :
    (ker f).toIdeal = RingHom.ker (f : H →ₐ[R] K)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_ker
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ker (f : H →ₐc[R] K) [Module.Flat R (H ⧸ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom)] {x : H} :
    x ∈ ker f ↔ f x = 0

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_kerOfSurjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_kerOfSurjective (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) {x : H} :
    x ∈ kerOfSurjective f hf ↔ f x = 0

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_bialgEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_bialgEquiv_symm_apply (I : HopfIdeal R H) (e : H ≃ₐc[R] K) :
    comapOfSurjective
        (I.comapOfSurjective e.symm.toBialgHom
          (by simpa only [BialgEquiv.toBialgHom_eq_coe, BialgEquiv.coe_toBialgHom] using
            EquivLike.surjective e.symm))
        e.toBialgHom
          (by simpa only [BialgEquiv.toBialgHom_eq_coe, BialgEquiv.coe_toBialgHom] using
            EquivLike.surjective e) = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_bot (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (⊥ : HopfIdeal R K).comapOfSurjective f hf = kerOfSurjective f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_comapOfSurjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_comapOfSurjective (I : HopfIdeal R L) (g : K →ₐc[R] L)
    (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (I.comapOfSurjective g hg).comapOfSurjective f hf =
      I.comapOfSurjective (g.comp f) (by rw [BialgHom.coe_comp]; exact hg.comp hf)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_eq_comap
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_eq_comap (I : HopfIdeal k K) (f : H →ₐc[k] K)
    [Module.Flat k (K ⧸ I.toIdeal)]
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal)]
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    I.comapOfSurjective f hf = I.comap f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_eq_comapOfSurjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_eq_comapOfSurjective_iff (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    I.comapOfSurjective f hf = J.comapOfSurjective f hf ↔ I = J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_eq_kerOfSurjective
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_eq_kerOfSurjective (I : HopfIdeal R K) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    I.comapOfSurjective f hf =
      kerOfSurjective ((Bialgebra.Quotient.mkBialgHom I.toIdeal).comp f)
        (by
          rw [BialgHom.coe_comp]
          exact (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_surjective R I.toIdeal).comp hf)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_iSup {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (I : ι → HopfIdeal R K)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (⨆ i, I i).comapOfSurjective f hf = ⨆ i, (I i).comapOfSurjective f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_id (I : HopfIdeal R H) :
    I.comapOfSurjective (BialgHom.id R H)
      (by rw [BialgHom.coe_id]; exact Function.surjective_id) = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_le_comapOfSurjective_iff
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_le_comapOfSurjective_iff (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) {I J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    I.comapOfSurjective f hf ≤ J.comapOfSurjective f hf ↔ I ≤ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_mono
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_mono (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    {I J : HopfIdeal R K} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    I.comapOfSurjective f hf ≤ J.comapOfSurjective f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_sSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_sSup (S : Set (HopfIdeal R K)) (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (sSup S).comapOfSurjective f hf =
      sSup ((fun I => I.comapOfSurjective f hf) '' S)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_sup (I J : HopfIdeal R K) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (I ⊔ J).comapOfSurjective f hf =
      I.comapOfSurjective f hf ⊔ J.comapOfSurjective f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comapOfSurjective_toIdeal (I : HopfIdeal R K) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    (I.comapOfSurjective f hf).toIdeal = Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_bot (f : H →ₐc[k] K)
    [Module.Flat k K] [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ RingHom.ker f.toAlgHom)] :
    haveI : Module.Flat k (K ⧸ (⊥ : HopfIdeal k K).toIdeal)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_comap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_comap (I : HopfIdeal k L) (g : K →ₐc[k] L)
    (f : H →ₐc[k] K)
    [Module.Flat k (L ⧸ I.toIdeal)]
    [Module.Flat k (K ⧸ Ideal.comap (g : K →+* L) I.toIdeal)]
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ Ideal.comap (g.comp f : H →+* L) I.toIdeal)] :
    haveI : Module.Flat k (K ⧸ (I.comap g).toIdeal)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_id (I : HopfIdeal k H)
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ I.toIdeal)] :
    haveI : Module.Flat k
        (H ⧸ Ideal.comap (BialgHom.id k H : H →+* H) I.toIdeal)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_mono
statement:
theorem comap_mono (f : H →ₐc[k] K) {I J : HopfIdeal k K} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    [Module.Flat k (K ⧸ I.toIdeal)] [Module.Flat k (K ⧸ J.toIdeal)]
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal)]
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) J.toIdeal)] :
    I.comap f ≤ J.comap f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comap_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comap_toIdeal (I : HopfIdeal k K) (f : H →ₐc[k] K)
    [Module.Flat k (K ⧸ I.toIdeal)]
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal)] :
    (I.comap f).toIdeal = Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.ker_comp
statement:
theorem ker_comp (f : H →ₐc[k] K) (g : K →ₐc[k] L)
    [Module.Flat k L] [Module.Flat k (K ⧸ RingHom.ker g.toAlgHom)]
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ RingHom.ker (g.comp f).toAlgHom)] :
    haveI : Module.Flat k (K ⧸ (ker g).toIdeal)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.le_of_comapOfSurjective_le_comapOfSurjective
TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_comap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_comap {I : HopfIdeal k K} {f : H →ₐc[k] K}
    [Module.Flat k (K ⧸ I.toIdeal)]
    [Module.Flat k (H ⧸ Ideal.comap (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal)] {h : H} :

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_comapOfSurjective
TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_map
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_map (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : (I.map f).comapOfSurjective f hf = I ⊔ kerOfSurjective f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.comapOfSurjective_map_of_bijective
statement:
theorem comapOfSurjective_map_of_bijective (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Bijective f) : (I.map f).comapOfSurjective f hf.2 = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bot (f : H →ₐc[R] K) : (⊥ : HopfIdeal R H).map f = ⊥

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_comapOfSurjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comapOfSurjective (J : HopfIdeal R K) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : (J.comapOfSurjective f hf).map f = J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_eq_bot_iff
statement:
theorem map_eq_bot_iff (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    I.map f = ⊥ ↔ I.toIdeal ≤ RingHom.ker (f : H →+* K)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker
statement:
theorem map_eq_bot_iff_le_ker (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : I.map f = ⊥ ↔ I ≤ kerOfSurjective f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_iSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_iSup {ι : Sort*} (I : ι → HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    (⨆ i, I i).map f = ⨆ i, (I i).map f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (I : HopfIdeal R H) : I.map (BialgHom.id R H) = I

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_le_iff
statement:
theorem map_le_iff {f : H →ₐc[R] K} {I : HopfIdeal R H} {J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    I.map f ≤ J ↔ ∀ ⦃x : H⦄, x ∈ I → f x ∈ J

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_le_iff_le_comapOfSurjective
statement:
theorem map_le_iff_le_comapOfSurjective {f : H →ₐc[R] K} (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    {I : HopfIdeal R H} {J : HopfIdeal R K} :
    I.map f ≤ J ↔ I ≤ J.comapOfSurjective f hf

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_map (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K) (g : K →ₐc[R] L) :
    (I.map f).map g = I.map (g.comp f)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_mono
statement:
theorem map_mono (f : H →ₐc[R] K) {I J : HopfIdeal R H} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    I.map f ≤ J.map f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_sSup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_sSup (S : Set (HopfIdeal R H)) (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    (sSup S).map f = sSup ((fun I => I.map f) '' S)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_sup
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_sup (I J : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    (I ⊔ J).map f = I.map f ⊔ J.map f

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_tensor_leftTensorIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_tensor_leftTensorIdeal (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (I : Ideal H) :
    Ideal.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.map f f : (H ⊗[R] H) →+* (K ⊗[R] K))
      (leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I) =
      leftTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := K) (Ideal.map f.toRingHom I)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_tensor_rightTensorIdeal
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_tensor_rightTensorIdeal (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (I : Ideal H) :
    Ideal.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.map f f : (H ⊗[R] H) →+* (K ⊗[R] K))
      (rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := H) I) =
      rightTensorIdeal (R := R) (H := K) (Ideal.map f.toRingHom I)

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.map_toIdeal
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_toIdeal (I : HopfIdeal R H) (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    (I.map f).toIdeal = Ideal.map (f : H →+* K) I.toIdeal

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_map_iff_of_surjective
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_map_iff_of_surjective {f : H →ₐc[R] K} (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    {I : HopfIdeal R H} {y : K} : y ∈ I.map f ↔ ∃ x ∈ I, f x = y

name: TauCeti.HopfIdeal.mem_map_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_map_of_mem (f : H →ₐc[R] K) {I : HopfIdeal R H} {x : H} (hx : x ∈ I) :
    f x ∈ I.map f

name: AddSubgroup.closure_mul_closure

name: Ideal.sup_pow_le_sup_pow_right

theorem Ideal.sup_pow_le_sup_pow_right {R : Type u} [Semiring R] (I J : Ideal R)

statement:

name: AlgHom.apply_eq_counit_of_ker_eq_augmentation
statement:
theorem apply_eq_counit_of_ker_eq_augmentation
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w}

    (f : A →ₐ[k] B)

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_inv_apply

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_ofConv

theorem mapEquiv_trans (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (d : N ≃ₗ[R] P) :
    (mapEquiv R e).trans (mapEquiv R d) = mapEquiv R (e.trans d)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.mapEquiv_ι
statement:
theorem mapEquiv_ι (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (a : M) :
    mapEquiv R e (ι R M a) = ι R N (e a)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_apply_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_apply_ι (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (a : M) :
    map R f (ι R M a) = ι R N (f a)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_comp_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp_map (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] P) :
    (map R g).comp (map R f) = map R (g.comp f)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_comp_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_comp_ι (f : M →ₗ[R] N) :
    (map R f).toLinearMap ∘ₗ ι R M = ι R N ∘ₗ f

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id :
    map R (LinearMap.id (R := R) (M := M)) = AlgHom.id R (SymmetricAlgebra R M)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_injective_of_leftInverse
statement:
theorem map_injective_of_leftInverse (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : Function.LeftInverse g f) : Function.Injective (map R f)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_leftInverse
statement:
theorem map_leftInverse {f : M →ₗ[R] N} {g : N →ₗ[R] M}
    (h : Function.LeftInverse g f) : Function.LeftInverse (map R g) (map R f)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_rightInverse
statement:
theorem map_rightInverse {f : M →ₗ[R] N} {g : N →ₗ[R] M}
    (h : Function.RightInverse g f) : Function.RightInverse (map R g) (map R f)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (h : Function.Surjective f) : Function.Surjective (map R f)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_surjective_of_rightInverse
statement:
theorem map_surjective_of_rightInverse (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : N →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : Function.RightInverse g f) : Function.Surjective (map R f)

name: SymmetricAlgebra.map_unique
statement:
theorem map_unique (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (g : SymmetricAlgebra R M →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R N) :
    (∀ a, g (ι R M a) = ι R N (f a)) ↔ g = map R f

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul_ι
    (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)) (s : K) (m : M) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (M := M)).symm φ).ofConv
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m) =
      s • (Multiplicative.toAdd φ m)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
statement:
theorem baseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
    (φ : Multiplicative (M →ₗ[k] A)) (m : M) :
    ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A) (M := M)).symm φ).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd φ m

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_ι (a : Multiplicative A) :
    ((gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (A := A)).symm a).ofConv
        (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k k 1) =
      Multiplicative.toAdd a

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv_symm_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv_symm_ι (s : K) :
    (gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv (k := k) (K := K)).symm
        (SymmetricAlgebra.ι K K s) =
      s ⊗ₜ[k] SymmetricAlgebra.ι k k 1

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv_tmul_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv_tmul_one (s : K) :
    gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv (k := k) (K := K) (s ⊗ₜ[k] 1) =
      algebraMap K (SymmetricAlgebra K K) s

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv_tmul_ι
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv_tmul_ι (s : K) (r : k) :
    gaScalarTensorBialgEquiv (k := k) (K := K)
        (s ⊗ₜ[k] SymmetricAlgebra.ι k k r) =
      s • SymmetricAlgebra.ι K K (algebraMap k K r)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAdd_baseChangePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (F : WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k M →ₐ[K] A)) (m : M) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (baseChangePointsMulEquiv F) m =
      F.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k M m)

name: TauCeti.AdditiveGroup.toAdd_gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAdd_gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv
    (F : WithConv (K ⊗[k] SymmetricAlgebra k k →ₐ[K] A)) :
    Multiplicative.toAdd (gaBaseChangePointsMulEquiv F) =
      F.ofConv (1 ⊗ₜ[k] ι k k 1)

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.extendPoint_apply
statement:
theorem extendPoint_apply (H : Type v) [Semiring H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H]
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (g : points (H := H) (CommAlgCat.of R R)) :
    extendPoint H A g = toConv ((Algebra.ofId R A).comp g.ofConv)

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.extendPoint_ofConv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendPoint_ofConv (H : Type v) [Semiring H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H]
    (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (g : points (H := H) (CommAlgCat.of R R)) (h : H) :
    (extendPoint H A g).ofConv h = algebraMap R A (g.ofConv h)

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.extendPoint_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendPoint_self (H : Type v) [Semiring H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H]
    (g : points (H := H) (CommAlgCat.of R R)) :
    extendPoint H (CommAlgCat.of R R) g = g

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.mapValue_extendPoint
statement:
theorem mapValue_extendPoint (H : Type v) [Semiring H] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R H]
    {A : CommAlgCat.{w} R} {B : CommAlgCat.{x} R} (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (g : points (H := H) (CommAlgCat.of R R)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) f (extendPoint H A g) = extendPoint H B g

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor_hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem pointsFunctor_hom_ext {K : Type v} [Semiring K] [_root_.HopfAlgebra R K]
    {α β : pointsFunctor (H := H) ⟶ pointsFunctor (H := K)}
    (h : ∀ (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R) (x : points (H := H) A), α.app A x = β.app A x) :
    α = β

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor_map_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pointsFunctor_map_apply_apply {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (φ : A ⟶ B)
    (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) (h : H) :
    (((pointsFunctor (H := H)).map φ f : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] B)).ofConv) h =
      φ.hom (f.ofConv h)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.grpObjMap_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem grpObjMap_comp {H K L : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R} (f : H ⟶ K) (g : K ⟶ L) :
    grpObjMap (f ≫ g) = grpObjMap g ≫ grpObjMap f

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.grpObjMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem grpObjMap_id (H : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R) :
    grpObjMap (𝟙 H) = 𝟙 (grpObj H)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.grpObjMap_injective
statement:
theorem grpObjMap_injective {H K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R} :
    Function.Injective (grpObjMap : (H ⟶ K) → (grpObj K ⟶ grpObj H))

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.grpObjMap_unop
statement:
@[simp]
theorem grpObjMap_unop {H K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R} (f : H ⟶ K) :
    (grpObjMap f).unop = CommAlgCat.ofHom f.hom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.grpObjMap_unop_hom
statement:
theorem grpObjMap_unop_hom {H K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R} (f : H ⟶ K) :
    (grpObjMap f).unop.hom = f.hom.toAlgHom

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma pointsFunctor_map_app_apply_apply {H K : (CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)ᵒᵖ}
    (φ : H ⟶ K) (A : CommAlgCat.{w} R)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := R) (H := H.unop) A) (h : K.unop) :
    ((((pointsFunctor (R := R)).map φ).app A f).ofConv) h =
      f.ofConv (φ.unop.hom h)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.pointsFunctor_obj
statement:
lemma pointsFunctor_obj (H : (CommHopfAlgCat.{v} R)ᵒᵖ) :
    (pointsFunctor (R := R)).obj H =
      HopfAlgebra.pointsFunctor (R := R) (H := H.unop)

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.whiskerLeft_grpObjMap_unop_hom
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_grpObjMap_unop_hom
    {H K : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R} (f : H ⟶ K) :
    (MonoidalCategoryStruct.whiskerLeft (grpObj H) (grpObjMap f)).unop.hom =
      Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R H) f.hom.toAlgHom

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeOpAlgEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeOpAlgEquiv_symm_tmul (l : L) (a : A) :
    (baseChangeOpAlgEquiv K L A).symm (MulOpposite.op (l ⊗ₜ[K] a)) =
      l ⊗ₜ[K] MulOpposite.op a

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeOpAlgEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeOpAlgEquiv_tmul (l : L) (a : Aᵐᵒᵖ) :
    baseChangeOpAlgEquiv K L A (l ⊗ₜ[K] a) = MulOpposite.op (l ⊗ₜ[K] a.unop)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeTensorAlgEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTensorAlgEquiv_symm_tmul (l₁ l₂ : L) (a : A) (b : B) :
    (baseChangeTensorAlgEquiv K L A B).symm ((l₁ ⊗ₜ[K] a) ⊗ₜ[L] (l₂ ⊗ₜ[K] b)) =
      (l₁ * l₂) ⊗ₜ[K] (a ⊗ₜ[K] b)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeTensorAlgEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTensorAlgEquiv_tmul (l : L) (a : A) (b : B) :
    baseChangeTensorAlgEquiv K L A B (l ⊗ₜ[K] (a ⊗ₜ[K] b)) = (l ⊗ₜ[K] a) ⊗ₜ[L] (1 ⊗ₜ[K] b)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeTowerAlgEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTowerAlgEquiv_symm_tmul (m : M) (a : A) :
    (baseChangeTowerAlgEquiv K L A M).symm (m ⊗ₜ[K] a) = m ⊗ₜ[L] (1 ⊗ₜ[K] a)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeTowerAlgEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTowerAlgEquiv_tmul (m : M) (l : L) (a : A) :
    baseChangeTowerAlgEquiv K L A M (m ⊗ₜ[L] (l ⊗ₜ[K] a)) = (l • m) ⊗ₜ[K] a

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeTowerRingEquiv_symm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTowerRingEquiv_symm_tmul (a : A) (m : M) :
    (baseChangeTowerRingEquiv K L A M).symm (a ⊗ₜ[K] m) =
      (1 ⊗ₜ[K] a) ⊗ₜ[L] m

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.baseChangeTowerRingEquiv_tmul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeTowerRingEquiv_tmul_tmul (l : L) (a : A) (m : M) :
    baseChangeTowerRingEquiv K L A M ((l ⊗ₜ[K] a) ⊗ₜ[L] m) = a ⊗ₜ[K] (l • m)

name: TauCeti.ScalarAut.baseChangeMap_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem baseChangeMap_smul {B : Type*} [Semiring B] [Algebra K B] (f : A →ₐ[K] B)
    (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : L ⊗[K] A) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id K L) f
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (σ : L →ₐ[K] L) (AlgHom.id K A) x) =
      σ • Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id K L) f x

name: TauCeti.ScalarAut.semilinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem semilinearMap_apply (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : L ⊗[K] A) :
    semilinearMap (A := A) σ x = σ • x

name: TauCeti.ScalarAut.smul_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_def (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (x : L ⊗[K] A) :
    σ • x = Algebra.TensorProduct.congr σ (.refl : A ≃ₐ[K] A) x

name: TauCeti.ScalarAut.smul_smulₛₗ
statement:
theorem smul_smulₛₗ (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L) (x : L ⊗[K] A) :
    σ • (a • x) = σ a • σ • x

name: TauCeti.ScalarAut.smul_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_tmul (σ : L ≃ₐ[K] L) (a : L) (x : A) :
    σ • (a ⊗ₜ[K] x) = σ a ⊗ₜ[K] x

name: TauCeti.lid_rTensor_distribBaseChange_symm
statement:
theorem lid_rTensor_distribBaseChange_symm {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {M : Type w} {N : Type x}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [Algebra R A] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] (l : A →ₗ[R] R) (y : A ⊗[R] M) (n : N) :
    TensorProduct.lid R (M ⊗[R] N) (l.rTensor (M ⊗[R] N)
        ((TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A M N).symm
          (y ⊗ₜ[A] ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R] n)))) =
      TensorProduct.lid R M (l.rTensor M y) ⊗ₜ[R] n

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeLeft_apply (x : H₁) : includeLeft (H₂ := H₂) x = x ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : H₂)

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeLeft_toAlgHom :
    (includeLeft : H₁ →ₐc[R] H₁ ⊗[R] H₂).toAlgHom = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeRight_apply (y : H₂) : includeRight (H₁ := H₁) y = (1 : H₁) ⊗ₜ[R] y

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_toAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem includeRight_toAlgHom :
    (includeRight : H₂ →ₐc[R] H₁ ⊗[R] H₂).toAlgHom = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.projectLeft_comp_includeLeft
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectLeft_comp_includeLeft :
    (projectLeft (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂)).comp includeLeft = BialgHom.id R H₁

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.projectLeft_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectLeft_tmul (x : H₁) (y : H₂) :
    projectLeft (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := H₂) y • x

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.projectRight_comp_includeRight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectRight_comp_includeRight :
    (projectRight (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂)).comp includeRight = BialgHom.id R H₂

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.TensorProduct.projectRight_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem projectRight_tmul (x : H₁) (y : H₂) :
    projectRight (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := H₁) x • y

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.mapDomain_projectLeft
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapDomain_projectLeft (g : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    toConv (g.ofConv.comp (Bialgebra.TensorProduct.projectLeft
      (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂)).toAlgHom) =
      pointsMulEquiv.symm (g, 1)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.mapDomain_projectRight
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapDomain_projectRight (g : WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    toConv (g.ofConv.comp (Bialgebra.TensorProduct.projectRight
      (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂)).toAlgHom) =
      pointsMulEquiv.symm ((1 : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A)), g)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := A)).symm p) =
      (pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := B)).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ p.1, AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ p.2)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul
statement:
theorem mapValue_pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_tmul (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (x : H₁) (y : H₂) :
    (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := A)).symm p)).ofConv
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      φ (p.1.ofConv x * p.2.ofConv y)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointsMulEquiv_apply (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv f =
      (AlgHom.mapDomain includeLeft f, AlgHom.mapDomain includeRight f)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).2)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_fst
statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_fst (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f)).1 =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).1

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_snd
statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_mapValue_snd (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (pointsMulEquiv (A := B) (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f)).2 =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ (pointsMulEquiv f).2

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv.symm p = toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap p.1.ofConv p.2.ofConv)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.pointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue_apply_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pointsMulEquiv_symm_mapValue_apply_tmul (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : WithConv (H₁ →ₐ[R] A) × WithConv (H₂ →ₐ[R] A)) (x : H₁) (y : H₂) :
    ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (H₁ := H₁) (H₂ := H₂) (A := B)).symm
        (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ p.1, AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ p.2)).ofConv
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) =
      φ (p.1.ofConv x) * φ (p.2.ofConv y)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.productMap_restrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem productMap_restrict (g : (H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A) :
    Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap (g.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft)
        (g.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) =
      g

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.restrictHom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem restrictHom_apply (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    restrictHom f = (AlgHom.mapDomain includeLeft f, AlgHom.mapDomain includeRight f)

name: TauCeti.AffineGroup.Product.restrictHom_mapValue
statement:
theorem restrictHom_mapValue (φ : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (f : WithConv ((H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    restrictHom (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁ ⊗[R] H₂) φ f) =
      (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₁) φ (restrictHom f).1,
        AlgHom.mapValue (H := H₂) φ (restrictHom f).2)

name: TauCeti.Algebra.TensorProduct.comp_productMap
statement:
theorem comp_productMap (φ : A →ₐ[R] B) (f₁ : H₁ →ₐ[R] A) (f₂ : H₂ →ₐ[R] A) :

      _root_.Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap (φ.comp f₁) (φ.comp f₂)

name: TauCeti.AlgHom.toConv_toLinearMap_comp_mul'
statement:

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.comulPoint_eq_include_mul

        (R := R) (H₁ := H) (H₂ := H)).toAlgHom *

        (R := R) (H₁ := H) (H₂ := H)).toAlgHom

statement:
theorem toConv_comp_comulAlgHom {A : Type*} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (phi : H ⊗[R] H →ₐ[R] A) :
    toConv (phi.comp (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R H)) =
      toConv (phi.comp (Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
        (R := R) (H₁ := H) (H₂ := H)).toAlgHom) *
      toConv (phi.comp (Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeRight
        (R := R) (H₁ := H) (H₂ := H)).toAlgHom)

name: TauCeti.Coalgebra.comul_eq_convMul_includeLeft_includeRight

      toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (A := C) (B := C)).toLinearMap *
        toConv (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := C) (B := C)).toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.LinearMap.mulTensor_add_left

name: TauCeti.LinearMap.mulTensor_apply_tmul

statement:

lemma mulTensor_convMul
    (s u : WithConv (C →ₗ[R] S)) (t v : WithConv (D →ₗ[R] S)) :

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.comp_conjugationAlgHom
statement:
theorem comp_conjugationAlgHom {A : Type w} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (phi : H ⊗[R] H →ₐ[R] A) :
    phi.comp (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)) =
      (toConv (phi.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft) *
        toConv (phi.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight) *
        (toConv (phi.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft))⁻¹).ofConv

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.conjugationAlgHom_coassoc
statement:
theorem conjugationAlgHom_coassoc :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.assoc R R R H H H).toAlgHom.comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R H) (AlgHom.id R H)).comp
          (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H))) =
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R H)
          (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H))).comp
        (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H))

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.conjugationAlgHom_counit_left
statement:

theorem conjugationAlgHom_counit_left :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.lid R H).toAlgHom.comp
        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R H) (AlgHom.id R H)).comp
          (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H))) =
      AlgHom.id R H

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.conjugationAlgHom_counit_right

theorem conjugationAlgHom_counit_right :

        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id R H) (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R H)).comp
          (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H))) =
      (1 : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] H)).ofConv

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.productMap_comp_conjugationAlgHom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem productMap_comp_conjugationAlgHom
    {A : Type w} [CommSemiring A] [Algebra R A]
    (g x : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] A)) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.productMap g.ofConv x.ofConv).comp
        (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)) =
      (g * x * g⁻¹).ofConv

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.productMap_id_one_comp_conjugationAlgHom
statement:

theorem productMap_id_one_comp_conjugationAlgHom :

      (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)) =
        (1 : WithConv (H →ₐ[R] H)).ofConv

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.productMap_one_id_comp_conjugationAlgHom
statement:

theorem productMap_one_id_comp_conjugationAlgHom :

      (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)) =
        AlgHom.id R H

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.tensorProduct_map_comp_conjugationAlgHom
statement:
theorem tensorProduct_map_comp_conjugationAlgHom
    {K : Type w} [CommSemiring K] [HopfAlgebra R K] (f : H →ₐc[R] K) :
    (Algebra.TensorProduct.map f.toAlgHom f.toAlgHom).comp
        (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)) =
      (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := K)).comp f.toAlgHom

name: TauCeti.HopfAlgebra.toConv_conjugationAlgHom
statement:
theorem toConv_conjugationAlgHom :
    toConv (conjugationAlgHom (R := R) (H := H)) =
      toConv (Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (H₁ := H) (H₂ := H)).toAlgHom *
        toConv
          (Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (H₁ := H) (H₂ := H)).toAlgHom *
        (toConv
          (Bialgebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft
            (R := R) (H₁ := H) (H₂ := H)).toAlgHom)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.groupYonedaPointsHomEquiv_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupYonedaPointsHomEquiv_map
    (H : (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R)ᵒᵖ) {A B : CommAlgCat.{u} R}
    (g : A ⟶ B) (f : ((groupYonedaPointsFunctor (R := R)).obj H).obj A) :
    groupYonedaPointsHomEquiv H B
        (((groupYonedaPointsFunctor (R := R)).obj H).map g f) =
      groupYonedaPointsHomEquiv H A f ≫ g

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.groupYonedaPointsHomEquiv_map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupYonedaPointsHomEquiv_map_app
    {H K : (_root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{u} R)ᵒᵖ} (f : H ⟶ K) (A : CommAlgCat.{u} R)
    (p : ((groupYonedaPointsFunctor (R := R)).obj H).obj A) :
    groupYonedaPointsHomEquiv K A
        (((groupYonedaPointsFunctor (R := R)).map f).app A p) =
      CommAlgCat.ofHom (f.unop.hom : K.unop →ₐ[R] H.unop) ≫

    (g : T ⟶ (Spec (CommRingCat.of H)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    schemePointsAlgΓMulEquiv H T g =
      WithConv.toConv (((algΓ (CommRingCat.of R)).map g ≫

    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) (f : H →ₐc[R] K)
    (g : T ⟶ (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) :
    schemePointsAlgΓMulEquiv H T
        (g ≫ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toAlgHom.toRingHom)).asOver
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) =
      AlgHom.mapDomain f (schemePointsAlgΓMulEquiv K T g)

    schemePointsAlgΓMulEquiv H S (φ ≫ g) =

name: TauCeti.CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeIsoPointsMulEquiv_mapPointsFunctor
statement:
lemma baseChangeIsoPointsMulEquiv_mapPointsFunctor
    {G : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{v} k}
    {HK GK : _root_.CommHopfAlgCat.{max w v} K}
    (e : HK ≅ baseChange (K := K) H)
    (gG : baseChange (K := K) G ⟶ GK)
    (f : H ⟶ G) (fK : HK ⟶ GK)
    (hcompat : e.hom ≫ baseChangeMap f ≫ gG = fK)
    (A : CommAlgCat.{x} K)
    (q : HopfAlgebra.points (R := K) (H := GK) A) :
    baseChangeIsoPointsMulEquiv e A
        (WithConv.toConv (q.ofConv.comp fK.hom.toAlgHom)) =
      WithConv.toConv
        ((baseChangePointsMulEquiv (K := K) A G
          (WithConv.toConv (q.ofConv.comp gG.hom.toAlgHom))).ofConv.comp
            f.hom.toAlgHom)
