name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.essImage_coordinateRingFunctor
statement:
theorem essImage_coordinateRingFunctor :
    (coordinateRingFunctor k).essImage = groupLikeSpannedProperty k

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupLikeSpannedProperty_iff (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, u} k) :
    groupLikeSpannedProperty k H ↔
      Subcoalgebra.groupLikeSetSpan (R := k) (C := H) Set.univ = ⊤

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty.of_surjective
statement:
theorem of_surjective (H K : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, u} k) (f : H ⟶ K)
    (hf : Function.Surjective (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom f))
    (hH : DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty k H) :
    DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty k K

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty.quotient
statement:
theorem quotient (H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, u} k) (I : HopfIdeal k H)
    (hH : DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty k H) :
    DiagonalizableGroup.groupLikeSpannedProperty k
      (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.quotient H I)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.finiteTypeGroupScheme_obj_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finiteTypeGroupScheme_obj_obj (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    (finiteTypeGroupScheme R G).obj.obj = groupScheme R G

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemeMap_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupSchemeMap_comp {G H K : FGCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : G ⟶ H) (g : H ⟶ K) :
    groupSchemeMap R (f ≫ g) = groupSchemeMap R g ≫ groupSchemeMap R f

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemeMap_def
statement:
theorem groupSchemeMap_def {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : G ⟶ H) :
    groupSchemeMap R f =
      eqToHom (groupScheme_def R H) ≫
        (AlgebraicGeometry.hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).map (coordinateMap R f).hom.op ≫
        eqToHom (groupScheme_def R G).symm

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemeMap_hom_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma groupSchemeMap_hom_left {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : G ⟶ H) :
    (groupSchemeMap R f).hom.hom.left =
      eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R H) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.toBialgHom (coordinateMap R f)).toAlgHom) ≫
        eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G).symm

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemeMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem groupSchemeMap_id (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    groupSchemeMap R (𝟙 G) = 𝟙 (groupScheme R G)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupScheme_X_hom
statement:
@[simp]
lemma groupScheme_X_hom (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    (groupScheme R G).X.hom =
      eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (MonoidAlgebra R G)))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupScheme_X_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma groupScheme_X_left (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    (groupScheme R G).X.left = Spec (CommRingCat.of (MonoidAlgebra R G))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupScheme_def
statement:
theorem groupScheme_def (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    groupScheme R G =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of R)).obj
        (Opposite.op (coordinateRing R G).obj)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupScheme_inv_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma groupScheme_inv_left (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ι[(groupScheme R G).X].left =
      eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (HopfAlgebra.antipodeAlgHom R (MonoidAlgebra R G))) ≫
      eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G).symm

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupScheme_mul_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma groupScheme_mul_left (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    μ[(groupScheme R G).X].left =
      eqToHom (groupScheme_tensor_X_left R G) ≫
        (pullbackSpecIso R (MonoidAlgebra R G) (MonoidAlgebra R G)).hom ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R (MonoidAlgebra R G))) ≫
        eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G).symm

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupScheme_one_left
statement:
@[simp]
lemma groupScheme_one_left (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    η[(groupScheme R G).X].left =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R (MonoidAlgebra R G))) ≫
      eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G).symm

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupScheme_tensor_X_left
statement:
@[simp↓]
lemma groupScheme_tensor_X_left (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) :
    ((groupScheme R G).X ⊗ (groupScheme R G).X).left =
      Limits.pullback
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (MonoidAlgebra R G))))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (MonoidAlgebra R G))))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemeFunctor_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem schemeFunctor_map {G H : (FGCommGrpCat.{u})ᵒᵖ} (f : G ⟶ H) :
    (schemeFunctor R).map f =
      eqToHom (schemeFunctor_obj R G) ≫ groupSchemeMap R f.unop ≫
        eqToHom (schemeFunctor_obj R H).symm

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemeFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem schemeFunctor_obj (G : (FGCommGrpCat.{u})ᵒᵖ) :
    (schemeFunctor R).obj G = groupScheme R G.unop

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.diagonalizableGroupSchemeProperty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalizableGroupSchemeProperty_iff
    (G : Grp (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))) :
    diagonalizableGroupSchemeProperty k G ↔
      ∃ H : FiniteTypeCommHopfAlgCat.{u, u} k,
        groupLikeSpannedProperty k H ∧
          Nonempty
            ((AlgebraicGeometry.hopfSpec (CommRingCat.of k)).obj (op H.obj) ≅ G)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.essImage_schemeFunctor
statement:
theorem essImage_schemeFunctor :
    (schemeFunctor k).essImage = diagonalizableGroupSchemeProperty k

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.characterGroupSchemeMap_def
statement:
theorem characterGroupSchemeMap_def (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (g : G) :
    characterGroupSchemeMap (R := R) G g =
      groupSchemeMap R (FGCommGrpCat.ofHom (uliftZPowersMulEquiv G g))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.cocharacterGroupSchemeMap_comp_characterGroupSchemeMap
statement:
theorem cocharacterGroupSchemeMap_comp_characterGroupSchemeMap
    (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (g : G) (psi : G →* Multiplicative ℤ) :
    cocharacterGroupSchemeMap (R := R) G psi ≫ characterGroupSchemeMap (R := R) G g =
      powEndGroupSchemeMap (R := R) (pairing g psi)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.cocharacterGroupSchemeMap_def
statement:
theorem cocharacterGroupSchemeMap_def (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (psi : G →* Multiplicative ℤ) :
    cocharacterGroupSchemeMap (R := R) G psi =
      groupSchemeMap R (FGCommGrpCat.ofHom
        ((MulEquiv.ulift.symm : Multiplicative ℤ ≃*
          ULift.{u} (Multiplicative ℤ)).toMonoidHom.comp psi))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.eqToHom_hom_hom_left
statement:
lemma eqToHom_hom_hom_left {G₁ G₂ : Grp (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)))}
    (h : G₁ = G₂) :
    (eqToHom h).hom.hom.left =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun K : Grp (Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of R))) ↦ K.X.left) h)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_apply_left_comp
statement:
lemma groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_apply_left_comp (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R G).X) :
    p.left ≫ eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G) =
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.mapMulEquiv
        (groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p)).left

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_groupSchemeMap
statement:
theorem groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_groupSchemeMap {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : G ⟶ H)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R H).X) :
    groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G
        (p ≫ (groupSchemeMap R f).hom.hom) =
      pointsMap (R := R) (A := A) (FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom f)
        (groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) H p)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (phi : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R G).X) :
    groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B) G
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom)).asOver
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ≫ p) =
      AlgHom.mapValue (H := MonoidAlgebra R G) phi
        (groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left
statement:
lemma groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply_left (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (f : WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R G →ₐ[R] A)) :
    ((groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G).symm f).left =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.ofConv) ≫
        eqToHom (groupScheme_X_left R G).symm

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_apply
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (multiplicativeGroupScheme R).X) :
    multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) p =
      schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) multiplicativeCharacterGroup p
        (ULift.up (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_characterGroupSchemeMap
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_characterGroupSchemeMap
    (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (g : G)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R G).X) :
    multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)
        (p ≫ (characterGroupSchemeMap (R := R) G g).hom.hom) =
      schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p g

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue (phi : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (multiplicativeGroupScheme R).X) :
    multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B)
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom)).asOver
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ≫ p) =
      Units.map phi.toMonoidHom
        (multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) p)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_powEndGroupSchemeMap
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv_powEndGroupSchemeMap (n : ℤ)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (multiplicativeGroupScheme R).X) :
    multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)
        (p ≫ (powEndGroupSchemeMap (R := R) n).hom.hom) =
      multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) p ^ n

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEndGroupSchemeMap_def
statement:
theorem powEndGroupSchemeMap_def (n : ℤ) :
    powEndGroupSchemeMap (R := R) n =
      characterGroupSchemeMap (R := R) multiplicativeCharacterGroup
        (ULift.up (Multiplicative.ofAdd n))

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemePointsMulEquiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_apply_coe (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R G).X) (g : G) :
    (schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p g : A) =
      (groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p).ofConv
        (MonoidAlgebra.single g 1)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemePointsMulEquiv_cocharacterGroupSchemeMap
statement:
@[simp high]
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_cocharacterGroupSchemeMap
    (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (psi : G →* Multiplicative ℤ)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (multiplicativeGroupScheme R).X) (g : G) :
    schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G
        (p ≫ (cocharacterGroupSchemeMap (R := R) G psi).hom.hom) g =
      multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) p ^ (psi g).toAdd

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemePointsMulEquiv_eq_pointsMulEquiv_groupSchemePointsMulEquiv
statement:
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_eq_pointsMulEquiv_groupSchemePointsMulEquiv
    (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u})
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R G).X) :
    schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p =
      pointsMulEquiv
        (groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemePointsMulEquiv_groupSchemeMap
statement:
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_groupSchemeMap
    {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{u}} (f : G ⟶ H)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R H).X) :
    schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G
        (p ≫ (groupSchemeMap R f).hom.hom) =
      (schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) H p).comp
        (FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom f)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue
statement:
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (phi : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (groupScheme R G).X) :
    schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := B) G
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom phi.toRingHom)).asOver
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ≫ p) =
      (Units.map phi.toMonoidHom).comp
        (schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G p)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemePointsMulEquiv_multiplicativeCharacterGroup_apply
statement:
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_multiplicativeCharacterGroup_apply
    (p : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of R)) ⟶
      (multiplicativeGroupScheme R).X) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) multiplicativeCharacterGroup p (ULift.up n) =
      multiplicativeGroupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) p ^ n.toAdd

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.schemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem schemePointsMulEquiv_symm_apply
    (G : FGCommGrpCat.{u}) (chi : G →* Aˣ) :
    (schemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G).symm chi =
      (groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) G).symm
        ((pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) (G := G)).symm chi)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.uliftZPowersMulEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uliftZPowersMulEquiv_apply (M : Type u) [CommGroup M]
    (m : M) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    uliftZPowersMulEquiv M m (ULift.up n) = m ^ n.toAdd

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.uliftZPowersMulEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uliftZPowersMulEquiv_symm_apply (M : Type u) [CommGroup M]
    (f : ULift.{u} (Multiplicative ℤ) →* M) :
    (uliftZPowersMulEquiv M).symm f = f (ULift.up (Multiplicative.ofAdd 1))

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.iterateFrobeniusPoints_add
statement:
theorem iterateFrobeniusPoints_add (m : ℕ) :
    iterateFrobeniusPoints p (n + m) (H := H) (A := A) =
      (iterateFrobeniusPoints p n).comp (iterateFrobeniusPoints p m)

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.iterateFrobeniusPoints_apply
statement:
theorem iterateFrobeniusPoints_apply (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[ℤ] A)) :
    iterateFrobeniusPoints p n f =
      toConv ((iterateFrobenius A p n).toIntAlgHom.comp f.ofConv)

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.iterateFrobeniusPoints_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem iterateFrobeniusPoints_apply_apply (f : WithConv (H →ₐ[ℤ] A)) (h : H) :
    (iterateFrobeniusPoints p n f).ofConv h = f.ofConv h ^ p ^ n

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.iterateFrobeniusPoints_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem iterateFrobeniusPoints_zero :
    iterateFrobeniusPoints p 0 (H := H) (A := A) = MonoidHom.id _

name: TauCeti.Bialgebra.mapValue_comp_iterateFrobeniusPoints
statement:
theorem mapValue_comp_iterateFrobeniusPoints (φ : A →ₐ[ℤ] B) :
    (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) φ).comp (iterateFrobeniusPoints p n (H := H) (A := A)) =
      (iterateFrobeniusPoints p n (H := H) (A := B)).comp (AlgHom.mapValue (H := H) φ)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue_iterateFrobenius
statement:
theorem groupSchemePointsMulEquiv_mapValue_iterateFrobenius (G : FGCommGrpCat)
    (q : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).asOver (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)) ⟶
      (groupScheme ℤ G).X) :
    groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := ℤ) (A := A) G
        ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (iterateFrobenius A p n).toIntAlgHom.toRingHom)).asOver
          (Spec (CommRingCat.of ℤ)) ≫ q) =
      Bialgebra.iterateFrobeniusPoints p n
        (groupSchemePointsMulEquiv (R := ℤ) (A := A) G q)

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powEnd_add (a b : ℤ) :
    powEnd (R := R) (A := A) (a + b) = powEnd a * powEnd b

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powEnd_neg (a : ℤ) :
    powEnd (R := R) (A := A) (-a) = (powEnd (R := R) (A := A) a)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.powEnd_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem powEnd_zero :
    powEnd (R := R) (A := A) 0 = 1

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.toAdditive_powEnd_eq_intCast
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toAdditive_powEnd_eq_intCast (z : ℤ) :
    MonoidHom.toAdditive (powEnd (R := R) (A := A) z) =
      Int.castRingHom
        (AddMonoid.End (Additive (WithConv (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative ℤ) →ₐ[R] A)))) z

name: TauCeti.DiagonalizableGroup.isClosedImmersion_groupSchemeMap_of_surjective
statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_groupSchemeMap_of_surjective {G H : FGCommGrpCat.{u}} (φ : G ⟶ H)
    (hφ : Function.Surjective (FGCommGrpCat.toMonoidHom φ)) :
    IsClosedImmersion (groupSchemeMap R φ).hom.hom.left

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.coe_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_mk {f : M →ₗ[R] N} (h) : ((⟨f, h⟩ : Hom R C M N) : M → N) = f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.coe_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_toLinearMap (f : Hom R C M N) : ⇑f.toLinearMap = f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_assoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_assoc (h : Hom R C P Q) (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp (comp h g) f = comp h (comp g f)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_id (f : Hom R C M N) : comp f (id R C M) = f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_toLinearMap (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    (g.comp f).toLinearMap = g.toLinearMap ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {f g : Hom R C M N} (h : ∀ m, f m = g m) : f = g

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.id_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_comp (f : Hom R C M N) : comp (id R C N) f = f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.id_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_toLinearMap : (id R C M).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.map_coact_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_coact_apply (f : Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap LinearMap.id (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m) =
      coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (f m)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.map_coact_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_coact_eq (f : Hom R C M N) :
    TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap LinearMap.id ∘ₗ coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) ∘ₗ f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.toLinearMap_injective
statement:
theorem toLinearMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (Hom.toLinearMap : Hom R C M N → M →ₗ[R] N)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coactComponent_apply
statement:
theorem coactComponent_apply (phi : C →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    coactComponent (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) phi m =
      _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi (coact m)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coactComponent_coactComponent
statement:
theorem coactComponent_coactComponent (phi psi : C →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    coactComponent (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) phi
        (coactComponent (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) psi m) =
      tensorPairComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi psi
        (Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M (coact m))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coact_coassoc
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coact_coassoc :
    TensorProduct.assoc R M C C ∘ₗ (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C ∘ₗ
        coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M ∘ₗ coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coact_comp_tensorComponent
statement:
theorem coact_comp_tensorComponent (phi : C →ₗ[R] R) :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) ∘ₗ
        _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi =
      _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M ⊗[R] C) phi ∘ₗ
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coassoc_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coassoc_apply (m : M) :
    TensorProduct.assoc R M C C
        ((coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M)).rTensor C (coact m)) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M (coact m)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {rho sigma : Comodule R C M} (h : rho.coact = sigma.coact) : rho = sigma

name: TauCeti.Comodule.instSelf_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem instSelf_coact :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := C) = Coalgebra.comul

name: TauCeti.Comodule.lTensor_counit_coact
statement:
@[simp]
theorem lTensor_counit_coact (m : M) :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor M (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m) = m ⊗ₜ[R] 1

name: TauCeti.Comodule.pairCoeff_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pairCoeff_tmul (phi psi : C →ₗ[R] R) (c d : C) :
    pairCoeff (R := R) phi psi (c ⊗ₜ[R] d) = phi c * psi d

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorComponent_comp_tensorComponent
statement:
theorem tensorComponent_comp_tensorComponent (phi psi : C →ₗ[R] R) :
    _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi ∘ₗ
        _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M ⊗[R] C) psi =
      tensorPairComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi psi ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorPairComponent_comp_lTensor_comul
statement:
theorem tensorPairComponent_comp_lTensor_comul {phi psi theta : C →ₗ[R] R}
    (h : pairCoeff (R := R) phi psi ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul = theta) :
    tensorPairComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi psi ∘ₗ Coalgebra.comul.lTensor M =
      _root_.LinearMap.tensorComponent (R := R) (M := M) theta

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorPairComponent_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorPairComponent_tmul (phi psi : C →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) (t : C ⊗[R] C) :
    tensorPairComponent (R := R) (M := M) phi psi (m ⊗ₜ[R] t) =
      pairCoeff (R := R) phi psi t • m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.mem_range
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_range {f : Hom R C M N} {n : N} :
    n ∈ range (R := R) (C := C) f ↔ ∃ m, f m = n

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.mem_range_self
statement:
theorem mem_range_self (f : Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    f m ∈ range (R := R) (C := C) f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.range_finite
statement:
theorem range_finite (f : Hom R C M N) [Module.Finite R M] :
    Module.Finite R (range (R := R) (C := C) f).toSubmodule

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.range_le_iff
statement:
theorem range_le_iff {f : Hom R C M N} {P : Subcomodule R C N} :
    range (R := R) (C := C) f ≤ P ↔ ∀ m, f m ∈ P

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.range_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem range_toSubmodule (f : Hom R C M N) :
    (range (R := R) (C := C) f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.bot_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem bot_toSubmodule : (⊥ : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule = (⊥ : Submodule R M)

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.coact_mem
statement:
theorem coact_mem (N : Subcomodule R C M) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ N) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map N.carrier.subtype (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.coact_mem_tensor_top
statement:
theorem coact_mem_tensor_top (m : M) :
    Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ∈
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (⊤ : Submodule R M).subtype
        (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {N P : Subcomodule R C M} (h : ∀ m : M, m ∈ N ↔ m ∈ P) : N = P

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.finite
statement:
theorem finite (N : Subcomodule R C M) [IsNoetherian R M] :
    Module.Finite R N.toSubmodule

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.isSimpleOrder_of_transitive
statement:
theorem isSimpleOrder_of_transitive {G : Type x} (v₀ : M) (hv₀ : v₀ ≠ 0)
    (act : G → M → M)
    (htrans : ∀ {v w : M}, v ≠ 0 → w ≠ 0 → ∃ g, act g w = v)
    (hmem : ∀ (N : Subcomodule R C M) (g : G) {w : M}, w ∈ N → act g w ∈ N) :
    IsSimpleOrder (Subcomodule R C M)

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.le_def
statement: theorem le_def {N P : Subcomodule R C M} : N ≤ P ↔ ∀ ⦃m : M⦄, m ∈ N → m ∈ P

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_bot (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) : (⊥ : Subcomodule R C M).map f = ⊥

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_finite
statement:
theorem map_finite (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) (A : Subcomodule R C M)
    [Module.Finite R A.toSubmodule] : Module.Finite R (A.map f).toSubmodule

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_id (A : Subcomodule R C M) : A.map (Comodule.Hom.id R C M) = A

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_le_iff
statement:
theorem map_le_iff {A : Subcomodule R C M} {f : Comodule.Hom R C M N} {B : Subcomodule R C N} :
    A.map f ≤ B ↔ ∀ ⦃m⦄, m ∈ A → f m ∈ B

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_map (A : Subcomodule R C M) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N)
    (g : Comodule.Hom R C N P) : (A.map f).map g = A.map (g.comp f)

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_mono
statement:
theorem map_mono (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) {A B : Subcomodule R C M} (hAB : A ≤ B) :
    A.map f ≤ B.map f

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_toSubmodule (A : Subcomodule R C M) (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    (A.map f).toSubmodule = A.toSubmodule.map f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.map_top_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_top_toSubmodule (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) :
    ((⊤ : Subcomodule R C M).map f).toSubmodule = LinearMap.range f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bot {m : M} : m ∈ (⊥ : Subcomodule R C M) ↔ m = 0

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_carrier {N : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} : m ∈ N.carrier ↔ m ∈ N

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_map
statement:
theorem mem_map {A : Subcomodule R C M} {f : Comodule.Hom R C M N} {n : N} :
    n ∈ A.map f ↔ ∃ m ∈ A, f m = n

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_map_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_map_of_mem (f : Comodule.Hom R C M N) {A : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M}
    (hm : m ∈ A) : f m ∈ A.map f

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_ofSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ofSubmodule {N : Submodule R M} {hN} {m : M} :
    m ∈ ofSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) N hN ↔ m ∈ N

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_toSubmodule {N : Subcomodule R C M} {m : M} : m ∈ N.toSubmodule ↔ m ∈ N

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.mem_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_top (m : M) : m ∈ (⊤ : Subcomodule R C M)

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ne_bot_iff
statement: theorem ne_bot_iff {N : Subcomodule R C M} : N ≠ ⊥ ↔ ∃ m ∈ N, m ≠ 0

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.ofSubmodule_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofSubmodule_carrier (N : Submodule R M) (hN) :
    (ofSubmodule (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) N hN).carrier = N

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.rid_lTensor_coact_mem
statement:
theorem rid_lTensor_coact_mem (N : Subcomodule R C M) (f : C →ₗ[R] R) {m : M} (hm : m ∈ N) :
    TensorProduct.rid R M
        (LinearMap.lTensor M f (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m)) ∈ N

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.toSubmodule_carrier
statement: theorem toSubmodule_carrier (N : Subcomodule R C M) : N.toSubmodule = N.carrier

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.toSubmodule_eq_bot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toSubmodule_eq_bot {N : Subcomodule R C M} : N.toSubmodule = ⊥ ↔ N = ⊥

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.toSubmodule_eq_top
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toSubmodule_eq_top {N : Subcomodule R C M} : N.toSubmodule = ⊤ ↔ N = ⊤

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.toSubmodule_le_toSubmodule
statement:
theorem toSubmodule_le_toSubmodule {N P : Subcomodule R C M} :
    N.toSubmodule ≤ P.toSubmodule ↔ N ≤ P

name: TauCeti.Subcomodule.top_toSubmodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem top_toSubmodule : (⊤ : Subcomodule R C M).toSubmodule = (⊤ : Submodule R M)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.fixedSubcomodule_eq_top_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem fixedSubcomodule_eq_top_iff :
    fixedSubcomodule R C M = ⊤ ↔
      ∀ m : M, coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m = m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.mem_fixedSubcomodule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_fixedSubcomodule {m : M} :
    m ∈ fixedSubcomodule R C M ↔ coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m = m ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_apply (f g : Hom R C M N) (m : M) : (f + g) m = f m + g m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_comp (g h : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp (g + h) f = comp g f + comp h f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.add_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_toLinearMap (f g : Hom R C M N) : (f + g).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap + g.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_add (g : Hom R C N P) (f h : Hom R C M N) :
    comp g (f + h) = comp g f + comp g h

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_smul (r : R) (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp g (r • f) = r • comp g f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.comp_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_zero (g : Hom R C N P) : comp g (0 : Hom R C M N) = 0

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_apply (r : R) (f : Hom R C M N) (m : M) : (r • f) m = r • f m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.smul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_comp (r : R) (g : Hom R C N P) (f : Hom R C M N) :
    comp (r • g) f = r • comp g f

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.smul_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_toLinearMap (r : R) (f : Hom R C M N) : (r • f).toLinearMap = r • f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.zero_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_apply (m : M) : (0 : Hom R C M N) m = 0

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.zero_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_comp (f : Hom R C M N) : comp (0 : Hom R C N P) f = 0

name: TauCeti.Comodule.Hom.zero_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zero_toLinearMap : (0 : Hom R C M N).toLinearMap = 0

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.add_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ N) (m : M) : (f + g) m = f m + g m

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.add_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_comp {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ N) (h : N ⟶ P) :
    (f + g) ≫ h = f ≫ h + g ≫ h

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.comp_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_add {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) (g h : N ⟶ P) :
    f ≫ (g + h) = f ≫ g + f ≫ h

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.comp_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_apply {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) (m : M) :
    (f ≫ g) m = g (f m)

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.comp_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comp_smul {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (r : R) (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    f ≫ (r • g) = r • (f ≫ g)

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.comp_zero
statement:
theorem comp_zero {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ (0 : N ⟶ P) = 0

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.forget₂_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forget₂_map {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).map f =
      SemimoduleCat.ofHom f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.forget₂_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forget₂_obj (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    (forget₂ (ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (SemimoduleCat.{w} R)).obj M =
      SemimoduleCat.of R M

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem hom_ext {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} {f g : M ⟶ N} (h : ∀ m, f m = g m) : f = g

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.id_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem id_apply (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) (m : M) : (𝟙 M : M ⟶ M) m = m

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) (m : M) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).hom m = e m

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_hom_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    ((isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).hom).toLinearMap = e.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) (n : N) :
    (isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).inv n = e.symm n

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_inv_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    ((isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h).inv).toLinearMap =
      e.symm.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoOfLinearEquiv_isoToLinearEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfLinearEquiv_isoToLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i)
      (by simp [i.hom.map_coact]) = i

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) (m : M) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i m = i.hom m

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_isoOfLinearEquiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_isoOfLinearEquiv {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (h) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (isoOfLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) e h) =
      e

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_refl
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_refl (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (Iso.refl M) = LinearEquiv.refl R M

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i.symm =
      (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) (n : N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm n = i.inv n

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_symm_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).symm.toLinearMap = i.inv.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_toLinearMap {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) :
    (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).toLinearMap = i.hom.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.isoToLinearEquiv_trans
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoToLinearEquiv_trans {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (i : M ≅ N) (j : N ≅ P) :
    isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) (i ≪≫ j) =
      (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) i).trans
        (isoToLinearEquiv (R := R) (C := C) j)

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_apply {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (r : R) (f : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (r • f) m = r • f m

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.smul_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_comp {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (r : R) (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    (r • f) ≫ g = r • (f ≫ g)

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.toLinearMap_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLinearMap_add {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f g : M ⟶ N) :
    (f + g).toLinearMap = f.toLinearMap + g.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.toLinearMap_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLinearMap_comp {M N P : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C} (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ P) :
    (f ≫ g).toLinearMap = g.toLinearMap.comp f.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.toLinearMap_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toLinearMap_id (M : ComoduleCat.{u, v, w} R C) : (𝟙 M : M ⟶ M).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id

name: TauCeti.ComoduleCat.toLinearMap_smul
statement:

name: TauCeti.Comodule.corestrictHom_comp_coalg_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem corestrictHom_comp_coalg_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E) (h : Hom R C M N) (m : M) :
    (letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (g.comp f)
     letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := N) (g.comp f)
     corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) (g.comp f) h m) =
      (letI : Comodule R D M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
       letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f
       letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) g
       letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := N) g
       corestrictHom (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) g
          (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) (N := N) f h) m)

theorem corestrictHom_comp_coalg_toLinearMap (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E) (h : Hom R C M N) :
    (letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (g.comp f)
     letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := N) (g.comp f)
     (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) (g.comp f) h).toLinearMap) =
      (letI : Comodule R D M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) f
       letI : Comodule R D N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := N) f
       letI : Comodule R E M := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) g
       letI : Comodule R E N := Corestrict (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := N) g
       (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := D) (D := E) (M := M) (N := N) g
          (corestrictHom (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) (M := M) (N := N) f h)).toLinearMap)

statement:
@[simp]
theorem corestrict_map_comp_coalg_apply (f : C →ₗc[R] D) (g : D →ₗc[R] E)
    {M N : ComoduleCat.{u, v, x} R C} (h : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :

name: TauCeti.Comodule.assoc_comp_tensorCombine_rTensor_comp_tensorCombine
statement:
theorem assoc_comp_tensorCombine_rTensor_comp_tensorCombine :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M ⊗[R] N) C C ∘ₗ
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C ∘ₗ
          tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] C) (N := N ⊗[R] C) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C ⊗[R] C) (M := M) (N := N) ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.assoc R M C C).toLinearMap
          (TensorProduct.assoc R N C C).toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.comm_tensorCombine_eq_distribBaseChange_symm_tmul
statement:
theorem comm_tensorCombine_eq_distribBaseChange_symm_tmul
    (p : M ⊗[R] A) (q : N ⊗[R] A) :
    TensorProduct.comm R (M ⊗[R] N) A
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := A) (M := M) (N := N) (p ⊗ₜ[R] q)) =
      (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A M N).symm
        (TensorProduct.comm R M A p ⊗ₜ[A] TensorProduct.comm R N A q)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.lTensor_comp_tensorCombine
statement:
theorem lTensor_comp_tensorCombine (φ : C →ₐ[R] D) :
    φ.toLinearMap.lTensor (M ⊗[R] N) ∘ₗ tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := D) (M := M) (N := N) ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (φ.toLinearMap.lTensor M) (φ.toLinearMap.lTensor N)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_coassoc
statement:
theorem tensorCoact_coassoc :
    TensorProduct.assoc R (M ⊗[R] N) C C ∘ₗ
        (tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)).rTensor C ∘ₗ
          tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      Coalgebra.comul.lTensor (M ⊗[R] N) ∘ₗ
        tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_counit
statement:
theorem tensorCoact_counit :
    Coalgebra.counit.lTensor (M ⊗[R] N) ∘ₗ

      (TensorProduct.mk R (M ⊗[R] N) R).flip 1

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_natural
statement:
theorem tensorCoact_natural [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N]
    [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M'] [Comodule R C M']
    [AddCommMonoid N'] [Module R N'] [Comodule R C N'] (f : Hom R C M M') (g : Hom R C N N') :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap)
        (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) ∘ₗ
        tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
        tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCoact_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem tensorCoact_tmul [Semiring C] [Bialgebra R C]
    [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [Comodule R C M]
    [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N] [Comodule R C N] (m : M) (n : N) :
    tensorCoact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N)
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m ⊗ₜ[R]
          coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) n)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_assoc
statement:
theorem tensorCombine_assoc (x : M ⊗[R] C) (y : N ⊗[R] C) (z : P ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.assoc R M N P).toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N) (N := P)
          (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) ⊗ₜ[R] z)) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N ⊗[R] P)
        (x ⊗ₜ[R] tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (N := P) (y ⊗ₜ[R] z))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem tensorCombine_assoc_symm (x : M ⊗[R] C) (y : N ⊗[R] C) (z : P ⊗[R] C) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.assoc R M N P).symm.toLinearMap LinearMap.id
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N ⊗[R] P)
          (x ⊗ₜ[R] tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (N := P) (y ⊗ₜ[R] z))) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M ⊗[R] N) (N := P)
        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) ⊗ₜ[R] z)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_comm
statement:

        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) (x ⊗ₜ[R] y)) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := N) (N := M) (y ⊗ₜ[R] x)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_lid
statement:
theorem tensorCombine_lid (r : R) (x : M ⊗[R] C) :

        (tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := R) (N := M)
          ((r ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)) ⊗ₜ[R] x)) =

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_lid_symm

        (((1 : R) ⊗ₜ[R] (1 : C)) ⊗ₜ[R] x) =
      TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.lid R M).symm.toLinearMap LinearMap.id x

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_natural
statement:

    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f g) (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C) ∘ₗ
        tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (N := N) =
      tensorCombine (R := R) (C := C) (M := M') (N := N') ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))
          (TensorProduct.map g (LinearMap.id : C →ₗ[R] C))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_rid_symm

name: TauCeti.Comodule.tensorCombine_tmul_tmul

name: Module.End.baseChange_comp_mapValue
statement:
theorem baseChange_comp_mapValue (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (u : M →ₗ[R] N)
    (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) (ψ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] N))
    (h : u.baseChange A ∘ₗ φ = ψ ∘ₗ u.baseChange A) :

name: Module.End.distribBaseChange_comp_mapValue
statement:
theorem distribBaseChange_comp_mapValue (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) (ψ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] N))
    (χ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] (M ⊗[R] N)))
    (h : (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A M N).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map φ ψ =
      χ ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A M N).symm.toLinearMap) :
    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R B M N).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (mapValue f φ) (mapValue f ψ) =
      mapValue f χ ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R B M N).symm.toLinearMap

    (h : ψ.restrictScalars R ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor M f.toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.rTensor M f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ φ.restrictScalars R) :
    ψ = mapValue f φ

theorem mapValue_add (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (φ ψ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) :
    mapValue f (φ + ψ) = mapValue f φ + mapValue f ψ

name: Module.End.mapValue_aeval
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_aeval (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) (p : A[X]) :
    mapValue f (aeval φ p) = aeval (mapValue f φ) (p.map f.toRingHom)

name: Module.End.mapValue_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_algebraMap (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (a : A) :
    mapValue f (algebraMap A (Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) a) =
      algebraMap B (Module.End B (B ⊗[R] M)) (f a)

name: Module.End.mapValue_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_comp (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (g : B →ₐ[R] C) (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) :
    mapValue (g.comp f) φ = mapValue g (mapValue f φ)

name: Module.End.mapValue_comp_rTensor
statement:
theorem mapValue_comp_rTensor (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) :
    (mapValue f φ).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor M f.toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.rTensor M f.toLinearMap ∘ₗ φ.restrictScalars R

name: Module.End.mapValue_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_id (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) :
    mapValue (AlgHom.id R A) φ = φ

name: Module.End.mapValue_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_mul (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (φ ψ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) :
    mapValue f (φ * ψ) = mapValue f φ * mapValue f ψ

name: Module.End.mapValue_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_one (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :
    mapValue f (1 : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) = 1

name: Module.End.mapValue_rTensor_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_rTensor_apply (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M))
    (z : A ⊗[R] M) :
    mapValue f φ (LinearMap.rTensor M f.toLinearMap z) =
      LinearMap.rTensor M f.toLinearMap (φ z)

name: Module.End.mapValue_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_tmul (f : A →ₐ[R] B) (φ : Module.End A (A ⊗[R] M)) (b : B) (m : M) :
    mapValue f φ (b ⊗ₜ[R] m) = b • LinearMap.rTensor M f.toLinearMap (φ (1 ⊗ₜ[R] m))

name: Module.End.mapValue_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapValue_zero (f : A →ₐ[R] B) :

name: TauCeti.rTensor_algHom_smul

statement:

        TensorProduct.map (endOfPoint V g) (endOfPoint W g) =
      endOfPoint (V ⊗[R] W) g ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A V W).symm.toLinearMap

theorem endOfPoint_tensor_of_coact_eq [Comodule R H (V ⊗[R] W)]

      tensorCoact (R := R) (C := H) (M := V) (N := W)) (g : H →ₐ[R] A) :
    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A V W).symm.toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (endOfPoint V g) (endOfPoint W g) =
      endOfPoint (V ⊗[R] W) g ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A V W).symm.toLinearMap

name: TauCeti.Comodule.endOfPoint_tensor_tmul
statement:
theorem endOfPoint_tensor_tmul (g : H →ₐ[R] A) (a b : A) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A V W).symm
        (endOfPoint V g (a ⊗ₜ[R] v) ⊗ₜ[A] endOfPoint W g (b ⊗ₜ[R] w)) =
      endOfPoint (V ⊗[R] W) g ((a * b) ⊗ₜ[R] (v ⊗ₜ[R] w))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.endOfPoint_tensor_tmul_of_coact_eq

    (hcoact : coact (R := R) (C := H) (M := V ⊗[R] W) =
      tensorCoact (R := R) (C := H) (M := V) (N := W))
    (g : H →ₐ[R] A) (a b : A) (v : V) (w : W) :
    (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.distribBaseChange R A V W).symm
        (endOfPoint V g (a ⊗ₜ[R] v) ⊗ₜ[A] endOfPoint W g (b ⊗ₜ[R] w)) =
      endOfPoint (V ⊗[R] W) g ((a * b) ⊗ₜ[R] (v ⊗ₜ[R] w))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.endOfPoint_tmul
statement:

lemma endOfPoint_tmul (g : H →ₐ[R] A) (a : A) (v : V) :

name: TauCeti.DirectSum.isInternal_comap

theorem DirectSum.isInternal_comap {R ι M N : Type*} [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    (ℳ : ι → Submodule R M) [DirectSum.Decomposition ℳ] (𝓝 : ι → Submodule R N)
    (f : N →ₗ[R] M) (hf : Function.Injective f)
    (hmem : ∀ i x, x ∈ 𝓝 i ↔ f x ∈ ℳ i)
    (hproj : ∀ i x, (DirectSum.decompose ℳ (f x) i : M) ∈ LinearMap.range f) :

    [∀ i, AddCommMonoid (N i)] [∀ i, Module R (N i)] (e : ∀ i, N i ≃ₗ[R] A i)
    (E : (⨁ i, N i) ≃ₗ[R] M)
    (hE : ∀ i (x : N i), E (DirectSum.lof R ι (fun i ↦ N i) i x) = (e i x : M)) :
    DirectSum.IsInternal A

    (ℳ : ι → Submodule R M) [DirectSum.Decomposition ℳ] (𝓝 : ι → Submodule R N)
    [DirectSum.Decomposition 𝓝] (f : N →ₗ[R] M) (hmem : ∀ i x, x ∈ 𝓝 i ↔ f x ∈ ℳ i)

name: TauCeti.DirectSum.map_decompose_shift
statement:
theorem DirectSum.map_decompose_shift {R ι κ M N : Type*} [Semiring R]
    [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq κ] [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M] [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]
    (ℳ : ι → Submodule R M) [DirectSum.Decomposition ℳ] (𝓝 : κ → Submodule R N)
    [DirectSum.Decomposition 𝓝] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (σ : ι → κ) (hσ : Function.Injective σ)

    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    {P : ObjectProperty C} {Q : ObjectProperty D} [Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (e : C ≌ D) (h : Q.inverseImage e.functor = P) :
    (e.congrFullSubcategory h).functor ⋙ Q.ι = P.ι ⋙ e.functor

name: CategoryTheory.Equivalence.congrFullSubcategory_functor_eq_lift
statement:

    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]
    {P : ObjectProperty C} {Q : ObjectProperty D} [Q.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms]
    (e : C ≌ D) (h : Q.inverseImage e.functor = P) :
    (e.congrFullSubcategory h).functor =
      Q.lift (P.ι ⋙ e.functor) (fun ⟨X, hX⟩ ↦ by rwa [← h] at hX)

name: CategoryTheory.Equivalence.congrFullSubcategory_inverse_comp_ι

    (e.congrFullSubcategory h).inverse ⋙ P.ι = Q.ι ⋙ e.inverse

name: CategoryTheory.Equivalence.congrFullSubcategory_inverse_eq_lift
statement:
theorem congrFullSubcategory_inverse_eq_lift
    {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} D]

    (e : C ≌ D) (h : Q.inverseImage e.functor = P) :
    (e.congrFullSubcategory h).inverse =
      P.lift (Q.ι ⋙ e.inverse) (fun ⟨Y, hY⟩ ↦ by

statement:
theorem endOfPoint_tmul_comp (π : C →ₐc[R] MonoidAlgebra R X)
    (f : MonoidAlgebra R X →ₐ[R] A) (a : A) (v : V) :
    Comodule.endOfPoint V (f.comp (π : C →ₐ[R] MonoidAlgebra R X)) (a ⊗ₜ[R] v) =
      a • TensorProduct.comm R V A
        (LinearMap.lTensor V f.toLinearMap
          (TensorProduct.map LinearMap.id (π : C →ₗc[R] MonoidAlgebra R X).toLinearMap
            (Comodule.coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := V) v)))

statement:
theorem endOfPoint_tmul_of_mem_weightSpace (π : C →ₐc[R] MonoidAlgebra R X)
    (f : MonoidAlgebra R X →ₐ[R] A) (a : A) {x : X} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ weightSpace V (π : C →ₗc[R] MonoidAlgebra R X) x) :
    Comodule.endOfPoint V (f.comp (π : C →ₐ[R] MonoidAlgebra R X)) (a ⊗ₜ[R] v) =
      (a * f (MonoidAlgebra.single x (1 : R))) ⊗ₜ[R] v

theorem _root_.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2nUnit_coe {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {m : Type v} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {i j : m} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : Rˣ) :
    (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2nUnit hij a).1 = Matrix.diagonal (fun r ↦
      if r = i then (a : R) else if r = j then ((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) else 1)

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2nUnit_decompose
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2nUnit_decompose
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    {m : Type v} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {i j : m} (hij : i ≠ j) (a : Rˣ) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2nUnit hij a =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (a : R) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm (-((a⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R)) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (a : R) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-1) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm 1 *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-1)

theorem _root_.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2nUnit_one {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

name: Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2n_decompose
statement:
theorem _root_.Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2n_decompose {K : Type u} [Field K]
    {m : Type v} [Fintype m] [DecidableEq m] {i j : m} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (a : K) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.diag2n hij a ha =
      Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm (-a⁻¹) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij a *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-1) *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij.symm 1 *
        Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup.transvection hij (-1)

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.diagonalTorusPoints_mul_rootSubgroupPoints_mul_inv
statement:
theorem diagonalTorusPoints_mul_rootSubgroupPoints_mul_inv {i j : Fin N} (hij : i ≠ j)
    (t : WithConv
      (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative (ULift.{u} (Fin N) →₀ ℤ)) →ₐ[R] A))
    (c : WithConv (AdditiveGroup.coordinateHopfAlgebra R →ₐ[R] A)) :
    diagonalTorusPoints t * rootSubgroupPoints hij c * (diagonalTorusPoints t)⁻¹ =
      rootSubgroupPoints hij
        ((AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A)).symm <|
          Multiplicative.ofAdd
            ((SplitTorus.pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) t (ULift.up i) : A) *
              Multiplicative.toAdd (AdditiveGroup.gaPointsMulEquiv c) *
              (((SplitTorus.pointsMulEquiv (R := R) (A := A) t
                (ULift.up j))⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A)))

    AlgHom.mapValue (H := coordinateHopfAlgebra R N) phi (diagonalTorusPoints f) =

      (MonoidAlgebra R (Multiplicative (ULift.{u} (Fin N) →₀ ℤ)) →ₐ[R] A)) :
    pointsMulEquiv N (diagonalTorusPoints f) =

name: WithConv.snd_comp_convMul
statement:
theorem snd_comp_convMul
    {R C B : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid C] [Module R C]
    [CoalgebraStruct R C] [Semiring B] [Algebra R B]
    (f g : WithConv (C →ₗ[R] DualNumber B)) :
    (TrivSqZeroExt.sndHom B B).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ (f * g).ofConv =
      (WithConv.toConv ((TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom R B B).toLinearMap ∘ₗ f.ofConv) *
        WithConv.toConv ((TrivSqZeroExt.sndHom B B).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ g.ofConv) +
      WithConv.toConv ((TrivSqZeroExt.sndHom B B).restrictScalars R ∘ₗ f.ofConv) *
        WithConv.toConv ((TrivSqZeroExt.fstHom R B B).toLinearMap ∘ₗ g.ofConv)).ofConv

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.generatedGroupScheme_def
statement:
theorem generatedGroupScheme_def :

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.generatedGroupSchemeι_def
statement:
theorem generatedGroupSchemeι_def :
    generatedGroupSchemeι n f =
      eqToHom (generatedGroupScheme_def n f) ≫
        CommHopfAlgCat.quotientSpecι (coordinateHopfAlgebra R n)

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.generatorToGeneratedGroupScheme_comp_ι

@[simp]
theorem generatorToGeneratedGroupScheme_comp_ι (i : ι) :

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.generatorToGeneratedGroupScheme_def
statement:
theorem generatorToGeneratedGroupScheme_def (i : ι) :

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientCongr_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerQuotientCongr_mk {H K : Subgroup G} (h : H = K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientCongr h (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk K (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (by rw [h]) g)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientCongr_symm_mk
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientCongr_symm_mk {H K : Subgroup G} (h : H = K)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (K : Set G)) :
    (normalizerQuotientCongr h).symm (normalizerQuotientMk K g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (by rw [h]) g)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_mk
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_mk (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal H (normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      QuotientGroup.mk' H (g : G)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_symm_mk
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_symm_mk (g : G) :
    (normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal H).symm (QuotientGroup.mk' H g) =
      normalizerQuotientMk H ⟨g, by simp [_root_.Subgroup.normalizer_eq_top (H := H)]⟩

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_comp_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_comp_mk (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1) :
    (normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ).comp (normalizerQuotientMk H) = φ

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_injective_iff
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_injective_iff (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1) :
    Function.Injective (normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ) ↔
      ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), φ g = 1 ↔ (g : G) ∈ H

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_mk
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_mk (H : Subgroup G) (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ (normalizerQuotientMk H g) = φ g

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientLift_surjective_of_surjective
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientLift_surjective_of_surjective (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G) →* M)
    (hφ : ∀ g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G), (g : G) ∈ H → φ g = 1)
    (hφsurj : Function.Surjective φ) :
    Function.Surjective (normalizerQuotientLift H φ hφ)

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_apply (H : Subgroup G) (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_div_mem
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_div_mem (H : Subgroup G)
    (g k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientMk H g = normalizerQuotientMk H k ↔ (g : G) / (k : G) ∈ H

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_exists_mul
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_eq_iff_exists_mul (H : Subgroup G)
    (g k : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientMk H g = normalizerQuotientMk H k ↔
      ∃ h ∈ H, h * (k : G) = g

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_eq_one_iff
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_eq_one_iff (H : Subgroup G)
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :
    normalizerQuotientMk H g = 1 ↔ (g : G) ∈ H

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_ker
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_ker (H : Subgroup G) : (normalizerQuotientMk H).ker =

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_range
statement: lemma normalizerQuotientMk_range (H : Subgroup G) : (normalizerQuotientMk H).range = ⊤

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk_surjective
statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientMk_surjective (H : Subgroup G) :

statement:

name: TauCeti.Subgroup.normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal_mk
statement:

lemma normalizerQuotientToQuotientOfNormal_mk (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set G)) :

      QuotientGroup.mk' H (g : G)

name: TauCeti.diagGL_mul_permutationGL
statement:
theorem diagGL_mul_permutationGL (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (t : Fin n → kˣ) :
    diagGL t * permutationGL (k := k) σ =
      permutationGL (k := k) σ * diagGL fun i ↦ t (σ i)

name: TauCeti.diagonalNormalizerPerm_eq_of_eq_diagGL_mul_permutationGL
statement:
theorem diagonalNormalizerPerm_eq_of_eq_diagGL_mul_permutationGL
    (g : Subgroup.normalizer (diagonalTorus k n : Set (GL (Fin n) k)))
    (d : Fin n → kˣ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (h : (g : GL (Fin n) k) = diagGL d * permutationGL (k := k) σ) :
    diagonalNormalizerPerm (k := k) (n := n) g = σ

name: TauCeti.diagonalNormalizerPerm_eq_one_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalNormalizerPerm_eq_one_iff
    (g : Subgroup.normalizer (diagonalTorus k n : Set (GL (Fin n) k))) :
    diagonalNormalizerPerm (k := k) (n := n) g = 1 ↔
      (g : GL (Fin n) k) ∈ diagonalTorus k n

name: TauCeti.diagonalNormalizerPerm_permutationGL
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalNormalizerPerm_permutationGL (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    diagonalNormalizerPerm (k := k) (n := n)
        ⟨permutationGL (k := k) σ, permutationGL_mem_normalizer σ⟩ = σ

name: TauCeti.diagonalNormalizerPerm_surjective
statement:
theorem diagonalNormalizerPerm_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (diagonalNormalizerPerm (k := k) (n := n))

name: TauCeti.diagonalNormalizerQuotientMulEquivPerm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalNormalizerQuotientMulEquivPerm_mk
    (g : Subgroup.normalizer (diagonalTorus k n : Set (GL (Fin n) k))) :
    diagonalNormalizerQuotientMulEquivPerm (k := k) (n := n)
        (g : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient (diagonalTorus k n)) =
      diagonalNormalizerPerm (k := k) (n := n) g

name: TauCeti.diagonalNormalizerQuotientMulEquivPerm_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalNormalizerQuotientMulEquivPerm_symm_apply (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    (diagonalNormalizerQuotientMulEquivPerm (k := k) (n := n)).symm σ =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk (diagonalTorus k n)
        ⟨permutationGL (k := k) σ, permutationGL_mem_normalizer σ⟩

name: TauCeti.diagonalNormalizer_mul_diagGL_mul_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem diagonalNormalizer_mul_diagGL_mul_inv
    (g : Subgroup.normalizer (diagonalTorus k n : Set (GL (Fin n) k)))
    (t : Fin n → kˣ) :
    (g : GL (Fin n) k) * diagGL t * (g : GL (Fin n) k)⁻¹ =
      diagGL (fun i ↦ t ((diagonalNormalizerPerm (k := k) (n := n) g).symm i))

name: TauCeti.exists_eq_diagGL_mul_permutationGL_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem exists_eq_diagGL_mul_permutationGL_of_forall_ne {g : GL (Fin n) k}
    (hsep : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ∃ t : Fin n → kˣ,
      g * diagGL t * g⁻¹ ∈ diagonalTorus k n ∧ t i ≠ t j) :
    ∃ d : Fin n → kˣ, ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
      g = diagGL d * permutationGL (k := k) σ

name: TauCeti.mem_normalizer_diagonalTorus_iff_exists
statement:
theorem mem_normalizer_diagonalTorus_iff_exists {g : GL (Fin n) k} :
    g ∈ Subgroup.normalizer (diagonalTorus k n : Set (GL (Fin n) k)) ↔
      ∃ d : Fin n → kˣ, ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n),
        g = diagGL d * permutationGL (k := k) σ

name: TauCeti.permutationGL_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem permutationGL_coe {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (σ : Equiv.Perm ι) :
    (permutationGL (k := k) σ : Matrix ι ι k) = σ⁻¹.permMatrix k

name: TauCeti.permutationGL_mem_normalizer
statement:
theorem permutationGL_mem_normalizer (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    permutationGL (k := k) σ ∈
      Subgroup.normalizer (diagonalTorus k n : Set (GL (Fin n) k))

name: TauCeti.permutationGL_mul_diagGL_mul_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem permutationGL_mul_diagGL_mul_inv (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (t : Fin n → kˣ) :
    permutationGL (k := k) σ * diagGL t * (permutationGL (k := k) σ)⁻¹ =
      diagGL (fun i ↦ t (σ⁻¹ i))

name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_inverseTranspose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_inverseTranspose (g : GL n A) :
    (inverseTranspose g : Matrix n n A) = ((g⁻¹ : GL n A) : Matrix n n A).transpose

name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.inverseTranspose_inverseTranspose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inverseTranspose_inverseTranspose (g : GL n A) :
    inverseTranspose (inverseTranspose g) = g

name: Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map_inverseTranspose
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_inverseTranspose {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (g : GL n A) :
    map f (inverseTranspose g) = inverseTranspose (map f g)

name: TauCeti.inverseTranspose_diagGL
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inverseTranspose_diagGL {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (d : ι → Aˣ) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.inverseTranspose (diagGL d) = diagGL (fun i => (d i)⁻¹)

name: TauCeti.inverseTranspose_transvectionUnit
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inverseTranspose_transvectionUnit {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {i j : n}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (c : A) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.inverseTranspose (transvectionUnit hij c) =
      transvectionUnit hij.symm (-c)

name: TauCeti.map_typeAGraphAutomorphism
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_typeAGraphAutomorphism {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (r : ℕ)
    (g : GL (Fin (r + 1)) A) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f (typeAGraphAutomorphism r A g) =
      typeAGraphAutomorphism r B (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f g)

name: TauCeti.map_typeAGraphConjugator
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_typeAGraphConjugator {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (f : A →+* B) (r : ℕ) :
    Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map f (typeAGraphConjugator r A) =
      typeAGraphConjugator r B

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_apply
statement:
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_apply (r : ℕ) (g : GL (Fin (r + 1)) A) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A g =
      typeAGraphConjugator r A * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.inverseTranspose g *
        (typeAGraphConjugator r A)⁻¹

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_diagGL
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_diagGL (r : ℕ) (d : Fin (r + 1) → Aˣ) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A (diagGL d) =
      diagGL (fun i => (d i.rev)⁻¹)

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_eq_iff_mul_conjugator_mul_transpose_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_eq_iff_mul_conjugator_mul_transpose_eq (r : ℕ)
    (g h : GL (Fin (r + 1)) A) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A g = h ↔
      (h : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A) *
            (typeAGraphConjugator r A : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A) *
            (g : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A).transpose =
          (typeAGraphConjugator r A : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A)

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_eq_iff_transpose_mul_conjugator_mul_eq
statement:
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_eq_iff_transpose_mul_conjugator_mul_eq (r : ℕ)
    (g h : GL (Fin (r + 1)) A) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A g = h ↔
      (g : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A).transpose *
            (typeAGraphConjugator r A : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A) *
            (h : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A) =
          (typeAGraphConjugator r A : Matrix (Fin (r + 1)) (Fin (r + 1)) A)

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_mul_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_mul_self (r : ℕ) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A * typeAGraphAutomorphism r A = 1

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_transvectionUnit
statement:
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_transvectionUnit (r : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (c : A) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A
        (transvectionUnit (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := i)).ne c) =
      transvectionUnit (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := i.rev)).ne c

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_transvectionUnit_lower
statement:
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_transvectionUnit_lower (r : ℕ) (i : Fin r) (c : A) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A
        (transvectionUnit (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := i)).ne' c) =
      transvectionUnit (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := i.rev)).ne' c

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_transvectionUnit_of_ne
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_transvectionUnit_of_ne (r : ℕ) {i j : Fin (r + 1)}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (c : A) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A (transvectionUnit hij c) =
      transvectionUnit (Fin.rev_injective.ne hij.symm)
        ((-1 : A) ^ ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ) + 1) * c)

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism_typeAGraphAutomorphism
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typeAGraphAutomorphism_typeAGraphAutomorphism (r : ℕ)
    (g : GL (Fin (r + 1)) A) :
    typeAGraphAutomorphism r A (typeAGraphAutomorphism r A g) = g

name: TauCeti.typeAGraphConjugator_mul_self
statement:
theorem typeAGraphConjugator_mul_self (r : ℕ) :
    typeAGraphConjugator r A * typeAGraphConjugator r A =
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.scalar (Fin (r + 1)) ((-1 : Aˣ) ^ r)

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.pointsMulEquiv_comp_typeAGraphCoordinateIso
statement:
theorem pointsMulEquiv_comp_typeAGraphCoordinateIso
    (A : CommAlgCat.{0} ℤ)
    (f : HopfAlgebra.points (R := ℤ) (H := coordinateHopfAlgebra ℤ (r + 1)) A) :
    pointsMulEquiv (r + 1)
        (toConv (f.ofConv.comp ((typeAGraphCoordinateIso r).hom.hom :
          coordinateHopfAlgebra ℤ (r + 1) →ₐ[ℤ] coordinateHopfAlgebra ℤ (r + 1)))) =
      TauCeti.typeAGraphAutomorphism r A (pointsMulEquiv (r + 1) f)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.counit_matrixCoefficient

theorem counit_matrixCoefficient (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :

        (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m) = φ m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply

theorem matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) :

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientBilinear_apply_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientLinear_apply

@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientLinear_apply (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficientTensor_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficientTensor_tmul (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficientTensor (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (φ ⊗ₜ[R] m) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_add (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m n : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (m + n) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m +
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ n

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_add_functional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_add_functional (φ ψ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ + ψ) m =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m +
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) ψ m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_counit_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_counit_self (c : C) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (M := C) (Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C)) c = c

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_def
statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_def (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m =
      TensorProduct.lid R C
        (TensorProduct.map φ LinearMap.id (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_groupLike
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_groupLike (g : GroupLike R C) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    letI : Comodule R C M

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_map (f : Hom R C M N) (φ : N →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (f m) =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (φ.comp f.toLinearMap) m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_smul (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (r : R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (r • m) =
      r • matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_smul_functional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_smul_functional (r : R) (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (r • φ) m =
      r • matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_trivial
statement:
theorem matrixCoefficient_trivial (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m = φ m • (1 : C)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_zero (φ : M →ₗ[R] R) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ 0 = 0

name: TauCeti.Comodule.matrixCoefficient_zero_functional
statement:
@[simp]
theorem matrixCoefficient_zero_functional (m : M) :
    matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (0 : M →ₗ[R] R) m = 0

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coact_eq_sum_basis_matrixCoefficient
statement:
theorem coact_eq_sum_basis_matrixCoefficient {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι] (b : Basis ι R M) (m : M) :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m =
      ∑ i, b i ⊗ₜ[R]
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (b.coord i) m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.comul_matrixCoefficient
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_matrixCoefficient (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C)
        (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m) =
      TensorProduct.map
        (matrixCoefficientLinear (R := R) (C := C) φ) LinearMap.id
        (coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) m)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.comul_matrixCoefficient_eq_sum
statement:
theorem comul_matrixCoefficient_eq_sum {ι : Type x} [Fintype ι]
    (b : Basis ι R M) (φ : Module.Dual R M) (m : M) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C)
        (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ m) =
      ∑ i, matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) φ (b i) ⊗ₜ[R]
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (b.coord i) m

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coact_basis_eq_sum_coefficientMatrix
statement:
theorem coact_basis_eq_sum_coefficientMatrix (b : Basis ι R M) (j : ι) :
    coact (R := R) (C := C) (M := M) (b j) =
      ∑ i, b i ⊗ₜ[R] coefficientMatrix (C := C) b i j

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coefficientMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem coefficientMatrix_apply (b : Basis ι R M) (i j : ι) :
    coefficientMatrix (C := C) b i j =
      matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (b.coord i) (b j)

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coefficientMatrix_corestrict
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coefficientMatrix_corestrict (b : Basis ι R M) (f : C →ₗc[R] D) :

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coefficientMatrix_mul_map_antipode
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coefficientMatrix_mul_map_antipode (b : Basis ι R M) :
    coefficientMatrix (C := C) b *
        (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b).map (HopfAlgebra.antipode R) = 1

name: TauCeti.Comodule.comul_coefficientMatrix_eq_sum
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_coefficientMatrix_eq_sum (b : Basis ι R M) (i j : ι) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (A := C) (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b i j) =
      ∑ k, coefficientMatrix (C := C) b i k ⊗ₜ[R] coefficientMatrix (C := C) b k j

name: TauCeti.Comodule.counit_coefficientMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem counit_coefficientMatrix [DecidableEq ι] (b : Basis ι R M) (i j : ι) :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (A := C) (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b i j) =
      if i = j then 1 else 0

name: TauCeti.Comodule.isUnit_det_coefficientMatrix
statement:
theorem isUnit_det_coefficientMatrix (b : Basis ι R M) :
    IsUnit (Matrix.det (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.map_antipode_mul_coefficientMatrix
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_antipode_mul_coefficientMatrix (b : Basis ι R M) :
    (coefficientMatrix (C := C) b).map (HopfAlgebra.antipode R) *
        coefficientMatrix (C := C) b = 1

name: TauCeti.Comodule.sum_antipode_mul_matrixCoefficient_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem sum_antipode_mul_matrixCoefficient_eq_algebraMap (b : Basis ι R M) (p q : ι) :
    (∑ x : ι, HopfAlgebra.antipode R
          (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (b.coord p) (b x)) *
        matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (b.coord x) (b q)) =
      algebraMap R C (b.coord p (b q))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.sum_matrixCoefficient_mul_antipode_eq_algebraMap
statement:
theorem sum_matrixCoefficient_mul_antipode_eq_algebraMap (b : Basis ι R M) (p q : ι) :
    (∑ x : ι, matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (b.coord p) (b x) *
        HopfAlgebra.antipode R
          (matrixCoefficient (R := R) (C := C) (b.coord x) (b q))) =
      algebraMap R C (b.coord p (b q))

name: AlgHom.pointsMulEquiv_comp_coordinateBialgHom
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgHom.pointsMulEquiv_comp_coordinateBialgHom
    {K : Type x} [CommRing K] [Algebra R K]
    (f : H →ₐ[R] K) (b : Module.Basis (Fin n) R M) :
    (GeneralLinear.pointsMulEquiv n
        (WithConv.toConv (f.comp (coordinateBialgHom (H := H) b).toAlgHom)) :

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coordinateBialgHom_antipode_X

@[simp]

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coordinateBialgHom_corestrict

name: TauCeti.Comodule.coordinateBialgHom_eq_unit_comp_counit_of_coact_eq_tmul_one
statement:

theorem coordinateBialgHom_eq_unit_comp_counit_of_coact_eq_tmul_one

name: TauCeti.Comodule.counit_basisFun_of_map_counit
statement:
theorem counit_basisFun_of_map_counit [Finite ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (hcounit : Y.map (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R S) = 1) :
    ∀ i j, Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (Y i j) =
      (Pi.basisFun R ι).repr ((Pi.basisFun R ι) j) i

name: TauCeti.Comodule.map_comul_iff
statement:
theorem map_comul_iff :
    Y.map (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R S) =
        Y.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R)) *
          Y.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R)) ↔
      ∀ i j, Coalgebra.comul (R := R) (Y i j) = ∑ k, Y i k ⊗ₜ[R] Y k j

name: TauCeti.Comodule.map_comul_map
statement:
theorem map_comul_map
    (hcomul : Y.map (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R S) =
      Y.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R)) *
        Y.map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R))) :
    (Y.map f).map (Bialgebra.comulAlgHom R T) =
      (Y.map f).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft (R := R) (S := R)) *
        (Y.map f).map (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R))

name: TauCeti.Comodule.map_counit_iff
statement:
theorem map_counit_iff [DecidableEq ι] :
    Y.map (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R S) = 1 ↔
      ∀ i j, Coalgebra.counit (R := R) (Y i j) = if i = j then 1 else 0

name: TauCeti.Comodule.map_counit_map
statement:
theorem map_counit_map [DecidableEq ι]
    (hcounit : Y.map (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R S) = 1) :
    (Y.map f).map (Bialgebra.counitAlgHom R T) = 1

theorem matrixCoact_apply_basisFun (j : ι) :

        (coordinateHopfAlgebraAlgEquiv R n

statement:
@[simp]
theorem coordinateBialgHomOfMultiplicative_map_genericMatrix
    (φ : coordinateHopfAlgebra R n →ₐc[R] S) :
    coordinateBialgHomOfMultiplicative R n ((genericMatrix R n).map φ)
        (Matrix.map_map.trans (map_comul_map_genericMatrix φ))
        (Matrix.map_map.trans (map_counit_map_genericMatrix φ)) = φ

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.map_counit_map_genericMatrix

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.pglPointsFunctor_map

theorem pglPointsFunctor_map {R : Type u} [CommRing R]

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.eq_mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms_of_apply_scalarExtensionMap_eq

statement:

    mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms (V := V) (φ ≫ ψ) =
      mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms (V := V) φ ≫

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms_id

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms_injective

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mapScalarExtensionAutomorphisms_tmul
    {A B : CommAlgCat.{w} R} (φ : A ⟶ B)

name: TauCeti.GeneralLinear.scalarExtensionMap_id

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.antipode_groupAlgebraAction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem antipode_groupAlgebraAction
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    HopfAlgebra.antipode L (groupAlgebraAction rho sigma x) =
      groupAlgebraAction rho sigma (HopfAlgebra.antipode L x)

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.coeff_groupAlgebraAction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_groupAlgebraAction
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) (m : Multiplicative M) :
    (groupAlgebraAction rho sigma x).coeff m =
      sigma (x.coeff (Multiplicative.ofAdd (rho sigma⁻¹ m.toAdd)))

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.comul_groupAlgebraAction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem comul_groupAlgebraAction
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    Coalgebra.comul (R := L) (groupAlgebraAction rho sigma x) =
      groupAlgebraTensorActionSemilinearEquiv rho sigma
        (Coalgebra.comul (R := L) x)

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.counit_groupAlgebraAction
statement:
@[simp]
theorem counit_groupAlgebraAction
    (rho : Representation ℤ (L ≃ₐ[k] L) M) (sigma : L ≃ₐ[k] L)
    (x : MonoidAlgebra L (Multiplicative M)) :
    Coalgebra.counit (R := L) (groupAlgebraAction rho sigma x) =
      sigma (Coalgebra.counit (R := L) x)

name: TauCeti.GaloisDescent.groupAlgebraActionSemilinearEquiv_apply
statement:
